ayahs.tl: Alif-Laam-Meeem
ayahs.en: Alif, Lam, Meem.

ayahs.ar: اللّٰهُ لَا٘ اِلٰهَ اِلَّا هُوَ الۡحَيُّ الۡقَيُّوۡمُؕ‏
ayahs.tl: Allaahu laaa ilaaha illaa Huwal Haiyul Qaiyoom
ayahs.en: Allah - there is no deity except Him, the Ever-Living, the Sustainer of existence.

ayahs.ar: نَزَّلَ عَلَيۡكَ الۡكِتٰبَ بِالۡحَقِّ مُصَدِّقًا لِّمَا بَيۡنَ يَدَيۡهِ وَاَنۡزَلَ التَّوۡرٰىةَ وَالۡاِنۡجِيۡلَۙ‏
ayahs.tl: Nazzala 'alaikal Kitaaba bilhaqqi musaddiqal limaa baina yadaihi wa anzalat Tawraata wal Injeel
ayahs.en: He has sent down upon you, [O Muhammad], the Book in truth, confirming what was before it. And He revealed the Torah and the Gospel.

ayahs.ar: مِنۡ قَبۡلُ هُدًي لِّلنَّاسِ وَاَنۡزَلَ الۡفُرۡقَانَ ࣢ؕ اِنَّ الَّذِيۡنَ كَفَرُوۡا بِاٰيٰتِ اللّٰهِ لَهُمۡ عَذَابٌ شَدِيۡدٌؕ وَاللّٰهُ عَزِيۡزٌ ذُو انۡتِقَامٍؕ‏
ayahs.tl: Min qablu hudal linnaasi wa anzalal Furqaan; innallazeena kafaroo bi Aayaatil laahi lahum 'azaabun shadeed; wallaahu 'azeezun zun tiqaam
ayahs.en: Before, as guidance for the people. And He revealed the Qur'an. Indeed, those who disbelieve in the verses of Allah will have a severe punishment, and Allah is exalted in Might, the Owner of Retribution.

ayahs.ar: اِنَّ اللّٰهَ لَا يَخۡفٰي عَلَيۡهِ شَيۡءٌ فِي الۡاَرۡضِ وَلَا فِي السَّمَآءِؕ‏
ayahs.tl: Innal laaha laa yakhfaa 'alaihi shai'un fil ardi wa laa fis samaaa'
ayahs.en: Indeed, from Allah nothing is hidden in the earth nor in the heaven.

ayahs.ar: هُوَ الَّذِيۡ يُصَوِّرُكُمۡ فِي الۡاَرۡحَامِ كَيۡفَ يَشَآءُؕ لَا٘ اِلٰهَ اِلَّا هُوَ الۡعَزِيۡزُ الۡحَكِيۡمُ
ayahs.tl: Huwal lazee yusawwirukum fil arhaami kaifa yashaaa'; laa ilaaha illaa Huwal 'Azeezul Hakeem
ayahs.en: It is He who forms you in the wombs however He wills. There is no deity except Him, the Exalted in Might, the Wise.

ayahs.ar: هُوَ الَّذِيۡ٘ اَنۡزَلَ عَلَيۡكَ الۡكِتٰبَ مِنۡهُ اٰيٰتٌ مُّحۡكَمٰتٌ هُنَّ اُمُّ الۡكِتٰبِ وَاُخَرُ مُتَشٰبِهٰتٌؕ فَاَمَّا الَّذِيۡنَ فِيۡ قُلُوۡبِهِمۡ زَيۡغٌ فَيَتَّبِعُوۡنَ مَا تَشَابَهَ مِنۡهُ ابۡتِغَآءَ الۡفِتۡنَةِ وَابۡتِغَآءَ تَاۡوِيۡلِهٖۚؔ وَمَا يَعۡلَمُ تَاۡوِيۡلَهٗ٘ اِلَّا اللّٰهُۘ࣡ وَالرّٰسِخُوۡنَ فِي الۡعِلۡمِ يَقُوۡلُوۡنَ اٰمَنَّا بِهٖۙ كُلٌّ مِّنۡ عِنۡدِ رَبِّنَاۚ وَمَا يَذَّكَّرُ اِلَّا٘ اُولُوا الۡاَلۡبَابِ
ayahs.tl: Huwal lazeee anzala 'alaikal Kitaaba minhu Aayaatum Muh kamaatun hunna Ummul Kitaabi wa ukharu Mutashaabihaatun faammal lazeena fee quloobihim ziyghun fa yattabi'oona ma tashaabaha minhubtighaaa 'alfitnati wabtighaaa'a taaweelih; wa maa ya'lamu taaweelahooo illal laah; warraasikhoona fil 'ilmi yaqooloona aamannaa bihee kullum min 'indi Rabbinaa; wa maa yazzakkaru illaaa ulul albaab
ayahs.en: It is He who has sent down to you, [O Muhammad], the Book; in it are verses [that are] precise - they are the foundation of the Book - and others unspecific. As for those in whose hearts is deviation [from truth], they will follow that of it which is unspecific, seeking discord and seeking an interpretation [suitable to them]. And no one knows its [true] interpretation except Allah. But those firm in knowledge say, "We believe in it. All [of it] is from our Lord." And no one will be reminded except those of understanding.

ayahs.ar: رَبَّنَا لَا تُزِغۡ قُلُوۡبَنَا بَعۡدَ اِذۡ هَدَيۡتَنَا وَهَبۡ لَنَا مِنۡ لَّدُنۡكَ رَحۡمَةًۚ اِنَّكَ اَنۡتَ الۡوَهَّابُ
ayahs.tl: Rabbanaa laa tuzigh quloobanaa ba'da iz hadaitanaa wa hab lanaa mil ladunka rahmah; innaka antal Wahhaab
ayahs.en: [Who say], "Our Lord, let not our hearts deviate after You have guided us and grant us from Yourself mercy. Indeed, You are the Bestower.

ayahs.ar: رَبَّنَا٘ اِنَّكَ جَامِعُ النَّاسِ لِيَوۡمٍ لَّا رَيۡبَ فِيۡهِؕ اِنَّ اللّٰهَ لَا يُخۡلِفُ الۡمِيۡعَادَࣖ‏
ayahs.tl: Rabbanaaa innaka jaami 'un-naasi li Yawmil laa raibafeeh; innal laaha laa yukhliful mee'aad
ayahs.en: Our Lord, surely You will gather the people for a Day about which there is no doubt. Indeed, Allah does not fail in His promise."

ayahs.ar: اِنَّ الَّذِيۡنَ كَفَرُوۡا لَنۡ تُغۡنِيَ عَنۡهُمۡ اَمۡوَالُهُمۡ وَلَا٘ اَوۡلَادُهُمۡ مِّنَ اللّٰهِ شَيۡـًٔاؕ وَاُولٰٓئِكَ هُمۡ وَقُوۡدُ النَّارِۙ‏
ayahs.tl: Innal lazeena kafaroo lan tughniya 'anhum amwaaluhum wa laaa awlaaduhum minal laahi shai'anw wa ulaaa'ika hum waqoodun Naar
ayahs.en: Indeed, those who disbelieve - never will their wealth or their children avail them against Allah at all. And it is they who are fuel for the Fire.

ayahs.ar: كَدَاۡبِ اٰلِ فِرۡعَوۡنَۙ وَالَّذِيۡنَ مِنۡ قَبۡلِهِمۡؕ كَذَّبُوۡا بِاٰيٰتِنَاۚ فَاَخَذَهُمُ اللّٰهُ بِذُنُوۡبِهِمۡؕ وَاللّٰهُ شَدِيۡدُ الۡعِقَابِ
ayahs.tl: Kadaabi Aali Fir'awna wallazeena min qablihim; kazzaboo bi Aayaatinaa fa akhazahumul laahu bizunoo bihim; wallaahu shadeedul 'iqaab
ayahs.en: [Theirs is] like the custom of the people of Pharaoh and those before them. They denied Our signs, so Allah seized them for their sins. And Allah is severe in penalty.

ayahs.ar: قُلۡ لِّلَّذِيۡنَ كَفَرُوۡا سَتُغۡلَبُوۡنَ وَتُحۡشَرُوۡنَ اِلٰي جَهَنَّمَؕ وَبِئۡسَ الۡمِهَادُ
ayahs.tl: Qul lillazeena kafaroosatughlaboona wa tuhsharoona ilaa jahannam; wa bi'sal mihaad
ayahs.en: Say to those who disbelieve, "You will be overcome and gathered together to Hell, and wretched is the resting place."

ayahs.ar: قَدۡ كَانَ لَكُمۡ اٰيَةٌ فِيۡ فِئَتَيۡنِ الۡتَقَتَاؕ فِئَةٌ تُقَاتِلُ فِيۡ سَبِيۡلِ اللّٰهِ وَاُخۡرٰي كَافِرَةٌ يَّرَوۡنَهُمۡ مِّثۡلَيۡهِمۡ رَاۡيَ الۡعَيۡنِؕ وَاللّٰهُ يُؤَيِّدُ بِنَصۡرِهٖ مَنۡ يَّشَآءُؕ اِنَّ فِيۡ ذٰلِكَ لَعِبۡرَةً لِّاُولِي الۡاَبۡصَارِ
ayahs.tl: Qad kaana lakum Aayatun fee fi'atainil taqataa fi'atun tuqaatilu fee sabeelil laahi wa ukhraa kaafiratuny yarawnahum mislaihim raayal 'ayn; wallaahu yu'ayyidu bi nasrihee mai yashaaa'; innaa fee zaalika la 'ibratal li ulil absaar
ayahs.en: Already there has been for you a sign in the two armies which met - one fighting in the cause of Allah and another of disbelievers. They saw them [to be] twice their [own] number by [their] eyesight. But Allah supports with His victory whom He wills. Indeed in that is a lesson for those of vision.

ayahs.ar: زُيِّنَ لِلنَّاسِ حُبُّ الشَّهَوٰتِ مِنَ النِّسَآءِ وَالۡبَنِيۡنَ وَالۡقَنَاطِيۡرِ الۡمُقَنۡطَرَةِ مِنَ الذَّهَبِ وَالۡفِضَّةِ وَالۡخَيۡلِ الۡمُسَوَّمَةِ وَالۡاَنۡعَامِ وَالۡحَرۡثِؕ ذٰلِكَ مَتَاعُ الۡحَيٰوةِ الدُّنۡيَاۚ وَاللّٰهُ عِنۡدَهٗ حُسۡنُ الۡمَاٰبِ
ayahs.tl: Zuyyina linnaasi hubbush shahawaati minannisaaa'i wal baneena walqanaateeril muqantarati minaz zahabi walfiddati walkhailil musawwamati wal an'aami walhars; zaalika mataa'ul hayaatid dunyaa wallaahu 'indahoo husnul ma-aab
ayahs.en: Beautified for people is the love of that which they desire - of women and sons, heaped-up sums of gold and silver, fine branded horses, and cattle and tilled land. That is the enjoyment of worldly life, but Allah has with Him the best return.

ayahs.ar: قُلۡ اَؤُنَبِّئُكُمۡ بِخَيۡرٍ مِّنۡ ذٰلِكُمۡؕ لِلَّذِيۡنَ اتَّقَوۡا عِنۡدَ رَبِّهِمۡ جَنّٰتٌ تَجۡرِيۡ مِنۡ تَحۡتِهَا الۡاَنۡهٰرُ خٰلِدِيۡنَ فِيۡهَا وَاَزۡوَاجٌ مُّطَهَّرَةٌ وَّرِضۡوَانٌ مِّنَ اللّٰهِؕ وَاللّٰهُ بَصِيۡرٌۭ بِالۡعِبَادِۚ‏
ayahs.tl: Qul a'unabbi 'ukum bikhairim min zaalikum; lillazeenat taqaw 'inda Rabbihim jannaatun tajree min tahtihal anhaaru khaalideena feehaa wa azwaajum mutahharatunw wa ridwaanum minal laah; wallaahu baseerum bil'ibaad
ayahs.en: Say, "Shall I inform you of [something] better than that? For those who fear Allah will be gardens in the presence of their Lord beneath which rivers flow, wherein they abide eternally, and purified spouses and approval from Allah. And Allah is Seeing of [His] servants -

ayahs.ar: اَلَّذِيۡنَ يَقُوۡلُوۡنَ رَبَّنَا٘ اِنَّنَا٘ اٰمَنَّا فَاغۡفِرۡ لَنَا ذُنُوۡبَنَا وَقِنَا عَذَابَ النَّارِۚ‏
ayahs.tl: Allazeena yaqooloona Rabbanaaa innanaaa aamannaa faghfir lanaa zunoobanaa wa qinaa 'azaaban Naar
ayahs.en: Those who say, "Our Lord, indeed we have believed, so forgive us our sins and protect us from the punishment of the Fire,"

ayahs.ar: اَلصّٰبِرِيۡنَ وَالصّٰدِقِيۡنَ وَالۡقٰنِتِيۡنَ وَالۡمُنۡفِقِيۡنَ وَالۡمُسۡتَغۡفِرِيۡنَ بِالۡاَسۡحَارِ
ayahs.tl: Assaabireena wassaa diqeena walqaaniteena walmunfiqeena walmus taghfireena bil ashaar
ayahs.en: The patient, the true, the obedient, those who spend [in the way of Allah], and those who seek forgiveness before dawn.

ayahs.ar: شَهِدَ اللّٰهُ اَنَّهٗ لَا٘ اِلٰهَ اِلَّا هُوَۙ وَالۡمَلٰٓئِكَةُ وَاُولُوا الۡعِلۡمِ قَآئِمًاۭ بِالۡقِسۡطِؕ لَا٘ اِلٰهَ اِلَّا هُوَ الۡعَزِيۡزُ الۡحَكِيۡمُؕ‏
ayahs.tl: Shahidal laahu annahoo laa ilaaha illaa Huwa walmalaaa'ikatu wa ulul 'ilmi qaaa'imam bilqist; laaa ilaaha illaa Huwal 'Azeezul Hakeem
ayahs.en: Allah witnesses that there is no deity except Him, and [so do] the angels and those of knowledge - [that He is] maintaining [creation] in justice. There is no deity except Him, the Exalted in Might, the Wise.

ayahs.ar: اِنَّ الدِّيۡنَ عِنۡدَ اللّٰهِ الۡاِسۡلَامُࣞ وَمَا اخۡتَلَفَ الَّذِيۡنَ اُوۡتُوا الۡكِتٰبَ اِلَّا مِنۭۡ بَعۡدِ مَا جَآءَهُمُ الۡعِلۡمُ بَغۡيًاۭ بَيۡنَهُمۡؕ وَمَنۡ يَّكۡفُرۡ بِاٰيٰتِ اللّٰهِ فَاِنَّ اللّٰهَ سَرِيۡعُ الۡحِسَابِ
ayahs.tl: Innad deena 'indal laahil Islaam; wa makhtalafal lazeena ootul Kitaaba illaa mim ba'di maa jaaa'ahumul 'ilmu baghyam bainahum; wa mai yakfur bi Aayaatil laahi fa innal laaha saree'ul hisaab
ayahs.en: Indeed, the religion in the sight of Allah is Islam. And those who were given the Scripture did not differ except after knowledge had come to them - out of jealous animosity between themselves. And whoever disbelieves in the verses of Allah, then indeed, Allah is swift in [taking] account.

ayahs.ar: فَاِنۡ حَآجُّوۡكَ فَقُلۡ اَسۡلَمۡتُ وَجۡهِيَ لِلّٰهِ وَمَنِ اتَّبَعَنِؕ وَقُلۡ لِّلَّذِيۡنَ اُوۡتُوا الۡكِتٰبَ وَالۡاُمِّيّٖنَ ءَاَسۡلَمۡتُمۡؕ فَاِنۡ اَسۡلَمُوۡا فَقَدِ اهۡتَدَوۡاۚ وَاِنۡ تَوَلَّوۡا فَاِنَّمَا عَلَيۡكَ الۡبَلٰغُؕ وَاللّٰهُ بَصِيۡرٌۭ بِالۡعِبَادِࣖ‏
ayahs.tl: Fa in haaajjooka faqul aslamtu wajhiya lillaahi wa manit taba'an; wa qul lillazeena ootul Kitaaba wal ummiyyeena 'a-aslamtum; fa in aslamoo faqadih tadaw wa in tawallaw fa innamaa 'alaikal balaagh; wallaahu baseerum bil 'ibaad
ayahs.en: So if they argue with you, say, "I have submitted myself to Allah [in Islam], and [so have] those who follow me." And say to those who were given the Scripture and [to] the unlearned, "Have you submitted yourselves?" And if they submit [in Islam], they are rightly guided; but if they turn away - then upon you is only the [duty of] notification. And Allah is Seeing of [His] servants.

ayahs.ar: اِنَّ الَّذِيۡنَ يَكۡفُرُوۡنَ بِاٰيٰتِ اللّٰهِ وَيَقۡتُلُوۡنَ النَّبِيّٖنَ بِغَيۡرِ حَقٍّۙ وَّيَقۡتُلُوۡنَ الَّذِيۡنَ يَاۡمُرُوۡنَ بِالۡقِسۡطِ مِنَ النَّاسِۙ فَبَشِّرۡهُمۡ بِعَذَابٍ اَلِيۡمٍ
ayahs.tl: Innal lazeena yakfuroona bi Aayaatil laahi wa yaqtuloonan Nabiyyeena bighairi haqqinw wa yaqtuloonal lazeena yaamuroona bilqisti minannaasi fabashirhum bi'azaabin aleem
ayahs.en: Those who disbelieve in the signs of Allah and kill the prophets without right and kill those who order justice from among the people - give them tidings of a painful punishment.

ayahs.ar: اُولٰٓئِكَ الَّذِيۡنَ حَبِطَتۡ اَعۡمَالُهُمۡ فِي الدُّنۡيَا وَالۡاٰخِرَةِؗ وَمَا لَهُمۡ مِّنۡ نّٰصِرِيۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Ulaaa'ikal lazeena habitat a'maaluhum fid dunyaa wal Aaakhirati wa maa lahum min naasireen
ayahs.en: They are the ones whose deeds have become worthless in this world and the Hereafter, and for them there will be no helpers.

ayahs.ar: اَلَمۡ تَرَ اِلَي الَّذِيۡنَ اُوۡتُوۡا نَصِيۡبًا مِّنَ الۡكِتٰبِ يُدۡعَوۡنَ اِلٰي كِتٰبِ اللّٰهِ لِيَحۡكُمَ بَيۡنَهُمۡ ثُمَّ يَتَوَلّٰي فَرِيۡقٌ مِّنۡهُمۡ وَهُمۡ مُّعۡرِضُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Alam tara ilal lazeena ootoo naseebam minal Kitaabi yud'awna ilaa Kitaabil laahi liyahkuma bainahum summa yatawallaa fareequm minhum wa hum mu'ridoon
ayahs.en: Do you not consider, [O Muhammad], those who were given a portion of the Scripture? They are invited to the Scripture of Allah that it should arbitrate between them; then a party of them turns away, and they are refusing.

ayahs.ar: ذٰلِكَ بِاَنَّهُمۡ قَالُوۡا لَنۡ تَمَسَّنَا النَّارُ اِلَّا٘ اَيَّامًا مَّعۡدُوۡدٰتٍࣕ وَّغَرَّهُمۡ فِيۡ دِيۡنِهِمۡ مَّا كَانُوۡا يَفۡتَرُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Zaalika bi annahum qaaloo lan tamassanan naaru illaaa ayyaamam ma'doodaatinw wa gharrahum fee deenihim maa kaanoo yaftaroon
ayahs.en: That is because they say, "Never will the Fire touch us except for [a few] numbered days," and [because] they were deluded in their religion by what they were inventing.

ayahs.ar: فَكَيۡفَ اِذَا جَمَعۡنٰهُمۡ لِيَوۡمٍ لَّا رَيۡبَ فِيۡهِࣞ وَوُفِّيَتۡ كُلُّ نَفۡسٍ مَّا كَسَبَتۡ وَهُمۡ لَا يُظۡلَمُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Fakaifa izaa jama'naahum li Yawmil laa raiba fee wa wuffiyat kullu nafsim maa kasabat wa hum laa yuzlamoon
ayahs.en: So how will it be when We assemble them for a Day about which there is no doubt? And each soul will be compensated [in full for] what it earned, and they will not be wronged.

ayahs.ar: قُلِ اللّٰهُمَّ مٰلِكَ الۡمُلۡكِ تُؤۡتِي الۡمُلۡكَ مَنۡ تَشَآءُ وَتَنۡزِعُ الۡمُلۡكَ مِمَّنۡ تَشَآءُؗ وَتُعِزُّ مَنۡ تَشَآءُ وَتُذِلُّ مَنۡ تَشَآءُؕ بِيَدِكَ الۡخَيۡرُؕ اِنَّكَ عَلٰي كُلِّ شَيۡءٍ قَدِيۡرٌ
ayahs.tl: Qulil laahumma Maalikal Mulki tu'til mulka man tashaaa'u wa tanzi'ulmulka mimman tashhaaa'u wa tu'izzu man tashaaa'u wa tuzillu man tashaaa'u biyadikal khairu innaka 'alaa kulli shai'in Qadeer
ayahs.en: Say, "O Allah, Owner of Sovereignty, You give sovereignty to whom You will and You take sovereignty away from whom You will. You honor whom You will and You humble whom You will. In Your hand is [all] good. Indeed, You are over all things competent.

ayahs.ar: تُوۡلِجُ الَّيۡلَ فِي النَّهَارِ وَتُوۡلِجُ النَّهَارَ فِي الَّيۡلِؗ وَتُخۡرِجُ الۡحَيَّ مِنَ الۡمَيِّتِ وَتُخۡرِجُ الۡمَيِّتَ مِنَ الۡحَيِّؗ وَتَرۡزُقُ مَنۡ تَشَآءُ بِغَيۡرِ حِسَابٍ
ayahs.tl: Toolijul laila fin nahaari wa toolijun nahaara fil laili wa tukhrijul haiya minalmaiyiti wa tukhrijulo maiyita minal haiyi wa tarzuqu man tashaaa'u bighari hisab
ayahs.en: You cause the night to enter the day, and You cause the day to enter the night; and You bring the living out of the dead, and You bring the dead out of the living. And You give provision to whom You will without account."

ayahs.ar: لَا يَتَّخِذِ الۡمُؤۡمِنُوۡنَ الۡكٰفِرِيۡنَ اَوۡلِيَآءَ مِنۡ دُوۡنِ الۡمُؤۡمِنِيۡنَۚ وَمَنۡ يَّفۡعَلۡ ذٰلِكَ فَلَيۡسَ مِنَ اللّٰهِ فِيۡ شَيۡءٍ اِلَّا٘ اَنۡ تَتَّقُوۡا مِنۡهُمۡ تُقٰىةًؕ وَيُحَذِّرُكُمُ اللّٰهُ نَفۡسَهٗؕ وَاِلَي اللّٰهِ الۡمَصِيۡرُ
ayahs.tl: Laa yattakhizil mu'minoonal kaafireena awliyaaa'a min doonil mu'mineena wa mai yaf'al zaalika falaisa minal laahi fee shai'in illaaa an tattaqoo minhum tuqaah; wa yuhazzirukumul laahu nafsah; wa ilal laahil maseer
ayahs.en: Let not believers take disbelievers as allies rather than believers. And whoever [of you] does that has nothing with Allah, except when taking precaution against them in prudence. And Allah warns you of Himself, and to Allah is the [final] destination.

ayahs.ar: قُلۡ اِنۡ تُخۡفُوۡا مَا فِيۡ صُدُوۡرِكُمۡ اَوۡ تُبۡدُوۡهُ يَعۡلَمۡهُ اللّٰهُؕ وَيَعۡلَمُ مَا فِي السَّمٰوٰتِ وَمَا فِي الۡاَرۡضِؕ وَاللّٰهُ عَلٰي كُلِّ شَيۡءٍ قَدِيۡرٌ
ayahs.tl: Qul in tukhfoo maa fee sudoorikum aw tubdoohu ya'lamhul laah; wa ya'lamu maa fis samaawaati wa maa fil ard; wallaahu 'alaa kulli shai'in Qadeer
ayahs.en: Say, "Whether you conceal what is in your breasts or reveal it, Allah knows it. And He knows that which is in the heavens and that which is on the earth. And Allah is over all things competent.

ayahs.ar: يَوۡمَ تَجِدُ كُلُّ نَفۡسٍ مَّا عَمِلَتۡ مِنۡ خَيۡرٍ مُّحۡضَرًاۛۚۖ وَّمَا عَمِلَتۡ مِنۡ سُوۡٓءٍۛۚ تَوَدُّ لَوۡ اَنَّ بَيۡنَهَا وَبَيۡنَهٗ٘ اَمَدًاۭ بَعِيۡدًاؕ وَيُحَذِّرُكُمُ اللّٰهُ نَفۡسَهٗؕ وَاللّٰهُ رَءُوۡفٌۭ بِالۡعِبَادِࣖ‏
ayahs.tl: Yawma tajidu kullu nafsim maa'amilat min khairim muhdaranw wa maa 'amilat min sooo'in tawaddu law anna bainahaa wa bainahooo amadam ba'eedaa; wa yuhazzirukumul laahu nafsah; wallaahu ra'oofum bil'ibaad
ayahs.en: The Day every soul will find what it has done of good present [before it] and what it has done of evil, it will wish that between itself and that [evil] was a great distance. And Allah warns you of Himself, and Allah is Kind to [His] servants."

ayahs.ar: قُلۡ اِنۡ كُنۡتُمۡ تُحِبُّوۡنَ اللّٰهَ فَاتَّبِعُوۡنِيۡ يُحۡبِبۡكُمُ اللّٰهُ وَيَغۡفِرۡ لَكُمۡ ذُنُوۡبَكُمۡؕ وَاللّٰهُ غَفُوۡرٌ رَّحِيۡمٌ
ayahs.tl: Qul in kuntum tuhibboonal laaha fattabi' oonee yuhbibkumul laahu wa yaghfir lakum zunoobakum; wallaahu Ghafoorur Raheem
ayahs.en: Say, [O Muhammad], "If you should love Allah, then follow me, [so] Allah will love you and forgive you your sins. And Allah is Forgiving and Merciful."

ayahs.ar: قُلۡ اَطِيۡعُوا اللّٰهَ وَالرَّسُوۡلَۚ فَاِنۡ تَوَلَّوۡا فَاِنَّ اللّٰهَ لَا يُحِبُّ الۡكٰفِرِيۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Qul atee'ul laaha war Rasoola fa in tawallaw fa innal laaha laa yuhibbul kaafireen
ayahs.en: Say, "Obey Allah and the Messenger." But if they turn away - then indeed, Allah does not like the disbelievers.

ayahs.ar: اِنَّ اللّٰهَ اصۡطَفٰ٘ي اٰدَمَ وَنُوۡحًا وَّاٰلَ اِبۡرٰهِيۡمَ وَاٰلَ عِمۡرٰنَ عَلَي الۡعٰلَمِيۡنَۙ‏
ayahs.tl: Innal laahas tafaaa Aadama wa Noohanw wa Aala Ibraaheema wa Aala Imraana 'alal 'aalameen
ayahs.en: Indeed, Allah chose Adam and Noah and the family of Abraham and the family of 'Imran over the worlds -

ayahs.ar: ذُرِّيَّةًۭ بَعۡضُهَا مِنۭۡ بَعۡضٍؕ وَاللّٰهُ سَمِيۡعٌ عَلِيۡمٌۚ‏
ayahs.tl: Zurriyyatam ba'duhaa mim ba'd; wallaahu Samee'un 'Aleem
ayahs.en: Descendants, some of them from others. And Allah is Hearing and Knowing.

ayahs.ar: اِذۡ قَالَتِ امۡرَاَتُ عِمۡرٰنَ رَبِّ اِنِّيۡ نَذَرۡتُ لَكَ مَا فِيۡ بَطۡنِيۡ مُحَرَّرًا فَتَقَبَّلۡ مِنِّيۡۚ اِنَّكَ اَنۡتَ السَّمِيۡعُ الۡعَلِيۡمُ
ayahs.tl: Iz qaalatim ra atu 'Imraana Rabbi innee nazartu laka maa fee batnee muharraran fataqabbal minnee innaka Antas Samee'ul 'Aleem
ayahs.en: [Mention, O Muhammad], when the wife of 'Imran said, "My Lord, indeed I have pledged to You what is in my womb, consecrated [for Your service], so accept this from me. Indeed, You are the Hearing, the Knowing."

ayahs.ar: فَلَمَّا وَضَعَتۡهَا قَالَتۡ رَبِّ اِنِّيۡ وَضَعۡتُهَا٘ اُنۡثٰيؕ وَاللّٰهُ اَعۡلَمُ بِمَا وَضَعَتۡؕ وَلَيۡسَ الذَّكَرُ كَالۡاُنۡثٰيۚ وَاِنِّيۡ سَمَّيۡتُهَا مَرۡيَمَ وَاِنِّيۡ٘ اُعِيۡذُهَا بِكَ وَذُرِّيَّتَهَا مِنَ الشَّيۡطٰنِ الرَّجِيۡمِ
ayahs.tl: Falammaa waqa'athaa qaalat Rabbi innee wada'tuhaaa unsaa wallaahu a'lamu bimaa wada'at wa laisaz zakaru kalunsaa wa innee sammaituhaa Maryama wa innee u'eezuhaa bika wa zurriyyatahaa minash Shaitaanir Rajeem
ayahs.en: But when she delivered her, she said, "My Lord, I have delivered a female." And Allah was most knowing of what she delivered, "And the male is not like the female. And I have named her Mary, and I seek refuge for her in You and [for] her descendants from Satan, the expelled [from the mercy of Allah]."

ayahs.ar: فَتَقَبَّلَهَا رَبُّهَا بِقَبُوۡلٍ حَسَنٍ وَّاَنۭۡ بَتَهَا نَبَاتًا حَسَنًاۙ وَّكَفَّلَهَا زَكَرِيَّاؕ كُلَّمَا دَخَلَ عَلَيۡهَا زَكَرِيَّا الۡمِحۡرَابَۙ وَجَدَ عِنۡدَهَا رِزۡقًاۚ قَالَ يٰمَرۡيَمُ اَنّٰي لَكِ هٰذَاؕ قَالَتۡ هُوَ مِنۡ عِنۡدِ اللّٰهِؕ اِنَّ اللّٰهَ يَرۡزُقُ مَنۡ يَّشَآءُ بِغَيۡرِ حِسَابٍ
ayahs.tl: Fataqabbalahaa Rabbuhaa biqaboolin hasaninw wa ambatahaa nabaatan hasananw wa kaffalahaa Zakariyyaa kullamaa dakhala 'alaihaa Zakariyyal Mihraaba wajada 'indahaa rizqan qaala yaa Maryamu annaa laki haazaa qaalat huwa min 'indil laahi innal laaha yarzuqu mai yashaaa'u bighairi hisaab
ayahs.en: So her Lord accepted her with good acceptance and caused her to grow in a good manner and put her in the care of Zechariah. Every time Zechariah entered upon her in the prayer chamber, he found with her provision. He said, "O Mary, from where is this [coming] to you?" She said, "It is from Allah. Indeed, Allah provides for whom He wills without account."

ayahs.ar: هُنَالِكَ دَعَا زَكَرِيَّا رَبَّهٗۚ قَالَ رَبِّ هَبۡ لِيۡ مِنۡ لَّدُنۡكَ ذُرِّيَّةً طَيِّبَةًۚ اِنَّكَ سَمِيۡعُ الدُّعَآءِ
ayahs.tl: Hunaaalika da'aa Zakariyyaa Rabbahoo qaala Rabbi hab lee mil ladunka zurriyyatan taiyibatan innaka samee'ud du'aaa'
ayahs.en: At that, Zechariah called upon his Lord, saying, "My Lord, grant me from Yourself a good offspring. Indeed, You are the Hearer of supplication."

ayahs.ar: فَنَادَتۡهُ الۡمَلٰٓئِكَةُ وَهُوَ قَآئِمٌ يُّصَلِّيۡ فِي الۡمِحۡرَابِۙ اَنَّ اللّٰهَ يُبَشِّرُكَ بِيَحۡيٰي مُصَدِّقًاۭ بِكَلِمَةٍ مِّنَ اللّٰهِ وَسَيِّدًا وَّحَصُوۡرًا وَّنَبِيًّا مِّنَ الصّٰلِحِيۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Fanaadat hul malaaa'ikatu wa huwa qaaa'imuny yusallee fil Mihraabi annal laaha yubashshiruka bi Yahyaa musaddiqam bi Kalimatim minal laahi wa saiyidanw wa hasooranw wa Nabiyyam minas saaliheen
ayahs.en: So the angels called him while he was standing in prayer in the chamber, "Indeed, Allah gives you good tidings of John, confirming a word from Allah and [who will be] honorable, abstaining [from women], and a prophet from among the righteous."

ayahs.ar: قَالَ رَبِّ اَنّٰي يَكُوۡنُ لِيۡ غُلٰمٌ وَّقَدۡ بَلَغَنِيَ الۡكِبَرُ وَامۡرَاَتِيۡ عَاقِرٌؕ قَالَ كَذٰلِكَ اللّٰهُ يَفۡعَلُ مَا يَشَآءُ
ayahs.tl: Qaala Rabbi annaa yakoonu lee ghulaamunw wa qad balaghaniyal kibaru wamraatee 'aaqirun qaala kazaalikal laahu yaf'alu maa yashaaa'
ayahs.en: He said, "My Lord, how will I have a boy when I have reached old age and my wife is barren?" The angel said, "Such is Allah; He does what He wills."

ayahs.ar: قَالَ رَبِّ اجۡعَلۡ لِّيۡ٘ اٰيَةًؕ قَالَ اٰيَتُكَ اَلَّا تُكَلِّمَ النَّاسَ ثَلٰثَةَ اَيَّامٍ اِلَّا رَمۡزًاؕ وَاذۡكُرۡ رَّبَّكَ كَثِيۡرًا وَّسَبِّحۡ بِالۡعَشِيِّ وَالۡاِبۡكَارِࣖ‏
ayahs.tl: Qaala Rabbij 'al leee Aayatan qaala Aaayatuka allaa tukalliman naasa salaasata ayyaamin illa ramzaa; wzkur Rabbaka kaseeranw wa sabbih bil'ashiyyi wal ibkaar
ayahs.en: He said, "My Lord, make for me a sign." He Said, "Your sign is that you will not [be able to] speak to the people for three days except by gesture. And remember your Lord much and exalt [Him with praise] in the evening and the morning."

ayahs.ar: وَاِذۡ قَالَتِ الۡمَلٰٓئِكَةُ يٰمَرۡيَمُ اِنَّ اللّٰهَ اصۡطَفٰىكِ وَطَهَّرَكِ وَاصۡطَفٰىكِ عَلٰي نِسَآءِ الۡعٰلَمِيۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wa iz qaalatil malaaa'ikatu yaa Ya Maryamu innal laahas tafaaki wa tahharaki wastafaaki 'alaa nisaaa'il 'aalameen
ayahs.en: And [mention] when the angels said, "O Mary, indeed Allah has chosen you and purified you and chosen you above the women of the worlds.

ayahs.ar: يٰمَرۡيَمُ اقۡنُتِيۡ لِرَبِّكِ وَاسۡجُدِيۡ وَارۡكَعِيۡ مَعَ الرّٰكِعِيۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Yaa Maryamuq nutee li Rabbiki wasjudee warka'ee ma'ar raaki'een
ayahs.en: O Mary, be devoutly obedient to your Lord and prostrate and bow with those who bow [in prayer]."

ayahs.ar: ذٰلِكَ مِنۡ اَنۭۡ بَآءِ الۡغَيۡبِ نُوۡحِيۡهِ اِلَيۡكَؕ وَمَا كُنۡتَ لَدَيۡهِمۡ اِذۡ يُلۡقُوۡنَ اَقۡلَامَهُمۡ اَيُّهُمۡ يَكۡفُلُ مَرۡيَمَࣕ وَمَا كُنۡتَ لَدَيۡهِمۡ اِذۡ يَخۡتَصِمُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Zaalika min ambaaa'il ghaibi nooheehi ilaik; wa maa kunta ladaihim iz yulqoona aqlaamahum ayyuhum yakfulu Maryama wa maa kunta ladaihim iz yakhtasimoon
ayahs.en: That is from the news of the unseen which We reveal to you, [O Muhammad]. And you were not with them when they cast their pens as to which of them should be responsible for Mary. Nor were you with them when they disputed.

ayahs.ar: اِذۡ قَالَتِ الۡمَلٰٓئِكَةُ يٰمَرۡيَمُ اِنَّ اللّٰهَ يُبَشِّرُكِ بِكَلِمَةٍ مِّنۡهُࣗۙ اسۡمُهُ الۡمَسِيۡحُ عِيۡسَي ابۡنُ مَرۡيَمَ وَجِيۡهًا فِي الدُّنۡيَا وَالۡاٰخِرَةِ وَمِنَ الۡمُقَرَّبِيۡنَۙ‏
ayahs.tl: Iz qaalatil malaaa'ikatu yaa Maryamu innal laaha yubashshiruki bi Kalimatim minhus muhul Maseeh u 'Eesab nu Maryama wajeehan fid dunyaa wal Aakhirati wa minal muqarrabeen
ayahs.en: [And mention] when the angels said, "O Mary, indeed Allah gives you good tidings of a word from Him, whose name will be the Messiah, Jesus, the son of Mary - distinguished in this world and the Hereafter and among those brought near [to Allah].

ayahs.ar: وَيُكَلِّمُ النَّاسَ فِي الۡمَهۡدِ وَكَهۡلًا وَّمِنَ الصّٰلِحِيۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wa yukallimun naasa filmahdi wa kahlanw wa minassaaliheen
ayahs.en: He will speak to the people in the cradle and in maturity and will be of the righteous."

ayahs.ar: قَالَتۡ رَبِّ اَنّٰي يَكُوۡنُ لِيۡ وَلَدٌ وَّلَمۡ يَمۡسَسۡنِيۡ بَشَرٌؕ قَالَ كَذٰلِكِ اللّٰهُ يَخۡلُقُ مَا يَشَآءُؕ اِذَا قَضٰ٘ي اَمۡرًا فَاِنَّمَا يَقُوۡلُ لَهٗ كُنۡ فَيَكُوۡنُ
ayahs.tl: Qaalat Rabbi annaa yakoonu ee waladunw wa lam yamsasnee basharun qaala kazaalikil laahu yakhluqu maa yashaaa'; izaa qadaaa amran fa innamaa yaqoolu lahoo kun fayakoon
ayahs.en: She said, "My Lord, how will I have a child when no man has touched me?" [The angel] said, "Such is Allah; He creates what He wills. When He decrees a matter, He only says to it, 'Be,' and it is.

ayahs.ar: وَيُعَلِّمُهُ الۡكِتٰبَ وَالۡحِكۡمَةَ وَالتَّوۡرٰىةَ وَالۡاِنۡجِيۡلَۚ‏
ayahs.tl: Wa yu'allimuhul Kitaaba wal Hikmata wat Tawraata wal Injeel
ayahs.en: And He will teach him writing and wisdom and the Torah and the Gospel

ayahs.ar: وَرَسُوۡلًا اِلٰي بَنِيۡ٘ اِسۡرَآءِيۡلَ ࣢ۙ اَنِّيۡ قَدۡ جِئۡتُكُمۡ بِاٰيَةٍ مِّنۡ رَّبِّكُمۡۚۙ اَنِّيۡ٘ اَخۡلُقُ لَكُمۡ مِّنَ الطِّيۡنِ كَهَيۡـَٔةِ الطَّيۡرِ فَاَنۡفُخُ فِيۡهِ فَيَكُوۡنُ طَيۡرًاۭ بِاِذۡنِ اللّٰهِۚ وَاُبۡرِئُ الۡاَكۡمَهَ وَالۡاَبۡرَصَ وَاُحۡيِ الۡمَوۡتٰي بِاِذۡنِ اللّٰهِۚ وَاُنَبِّئُكُمۡ بِمَا تَاۡكُلُوۡنَ وَمَا تَدَّخِرُوۡنَۙ فِيۡ بُيُوۡتِكُمۡؕ اِنَّ فِيۡ ذٰلِكَ لَاٰيَةً لَّكُمۡ اِنۡ كُنۡتُمۡ مُّؤۡمِنِيۡنَۚ‏
ayahs.tl: Wa Rasoolan ilaa Baneee Israaa'eela annee qad ji'tukum bi Aayatim mir Rabbikum annee akhluqu lakum minatteeni kahai 'atittairi fa anfukhu feehi fayakoonu tairam bi iznil laahi wa ubri'ul akmaha wal abrasa wa uhyil mawtaa bi iznil laahi wa unabbi'ukum bimaa taakuloona wa maa taddakhiroona fee buyootikum; inna fee zaalika la Aayatal lakum in kuntum mu'mineen
ayahs.en: And [make him] a messenger to the Children of Israel, [who will say], 'Indeed I have come to you with a sign from your Lord in that I design for you from clay [that which is] like the form of a bird, then I breathe into it and it becomes a bird by permission of Allah. And I cure the blind and the leper, and I give life to the dead - by permission of Allah. And I inform you of what you eat and what you store in your houses. Indeed in that is a sign for you, if you are believers.

ayahs.ar: وَمُصَدِّقًا لِّمَا بَيۡنَ يَدَيَّ مِنَ التَّوۡرٰىةِ وَلِاُحِلَّ لَكُمۡ بَعۡضَ الَّذِيۡ حُرِّمَ عَلَيۡكُمۡ وَجِئۡتُكُمۡ بِاٰيَةٍ مِّنۡ رَّبِّكُمۡࣞ فَاتَّقُوا اللّٰهَ وَاَطِيۡعُوۡنِ
ayahs.tl: Wa musaddiqal limaa baina yadaiya minat Tawraati wa liuhilla lakum ba'dal lazee hurrima 'alaikum; wa ji'tukum bi Aayatim mir Rabbikum fattaqul laaha wa atee'oon
ayahs.en: And [I have come] confirming what was before me of the Torah and to make lawful for you some of what was forbidden to you. And I have come to you with a sign from your Lord, so fear Allah and obey me.

ayahs.ar: اِنَّ اللّٰهَ رَبِّيۡ وَرَبُّكُمۡ فَاعۡبُدُوۡهُؕ هٰذَا صِرَاطٌ مُّسۡتَقِيۡمٌ
ayahs.tl: Innal laaha Rabbee wa Rabbukum fa'budooh; haazaa Siraatum Mustaqeem
ayahs.en: Indeed, Allah is my Lord and your Lord, so worship Him. That is the straight path."

ayahs.ar: فَلَمَّا٘ اَحَسَّ عِيۡسٰي مِنۡهُمُ الۡكُفۡرَ قَالَ مَنۡ اَنۡصَارِيۡ٘ اِلَي اللّٰهِؕ قَالَ الۡحَوَارِيُّوۡنَ نَحۡنُ اَنۡصَارُ اللّٰهِۚ اٰمَنَّا بِاللّٰهِۚ وَاشۡهَدۡ بِاَنَّا مُسۡلِمُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Falammaaa ahassa 'Eesaa minhumul kufra qaala man ansaaree ilal laahi qaalal Hawaariyyoona nahnu ansaarul laahi aamannaa billaahi washhad bi annaa muslimoon
ayahs.en: But when Jesus felt [persistence in] disbelief from them, he said, "Who are my supporters for [the cause of] Allah?" The disciples said, "We are supporters for Allah. We have believed in Allah and testify that we are Muslims [submitting to Him].

ayahs.ar: رَبَّنَا٘ اٰمَنَّا بِمَا٘ اَنۡزَلۡتَ وَاتَّبَعۡنَا الرَّسُوۡلَ فَاكۡتُبۡنَا مَعَ الشّٰهِدِيۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Rabbanaaa aamannaa bimaaa anzalta wattaba'nar Rasoola faktubnaa ma'ash shaahideen
ayahs.en: Our Lord, we have believed in what You revealed and have followed the messenger Jesus, so register us among the witnesses [to truth]."

ayahs.ar: وَمَكَرُوۡا وَمَكَرَ اللّٰهُؕ وَاللّٰهُ خَيۡرُ الۡمٰكِرِيۡنَࣖ‏
ayahs.tl: Wa makaroo wa makaral laahu wallaahu khairul maakireen
ayahs.en: And the disbelievers planned, but Allah planned. And Allah is the best of planners.

ayahs.ar: اِذۡ قَالَ اللّٰهُ يٰعِيۡسٰ٘ي اِنِّيۡ مُتَوَفِّيۡكَ وَرَافِعُكَ اِلَيَّ وَمُطَهِّرُكَ مِنَ الَّذِيۡنَ كَفَرُوۡا وَجَاعِلُ الَّذِيۡنَ اتَّبَعُوۡكَ فَوۡقَ الَّذِيۡنَ كَفَرُوۡ٘ا اِلٰي يَوۡمِ الۡقِيٰمَةِۚ ثُمَّ اِلَيَّ مَرۡجِعُكُمۡ فَاَحۡكُمُ بَيۡنَكُمۡ فِيۡمَا كُنۡتُمۡ فِيۡهِ تَخۡتَلِفُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Iz qaalal laahu yaa 'Eesaaa innee mutawaffeeka wa raafi'uka ilaiya wa mutah hiruka minal lazeena kafaroo wa jaa'ilul lazeenattaba ooka fawqal lazeena kafarooo ilaa Yawmil Qiyaamati summa ilaiya marji'ukum fa ahkumu bainakum feemaa kuntum feehi takhtaliifoon
ayahs.en: [Mention] when Allah said, "O Jesus, indeed I will take you and raise you to Myself and purify you from those who disbelieve and make those who follow you [in submission to Allah alone] superior to those who disbelieve until the Day of Resurrection. Then to Me is your return, and I will judge between you concerning that in which you used to differ.

ayahs.ar: فَاَمَّا الَّذِيۡنَ كَفَرُوۡا فَاُعَذِّبُهُمۡ عَذَابًا شَدِيۡدًا فِي الدُّنۡيَا وَالۡاٰخِرَةِؗ وَمَا لَهُمۡ مِّنۡ نّٰصِرِيۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Fa ammal lazeena kafaroo fa u'az zibuhum 'azaaban shadeedan fiddunyaa wal Aakhirati wa maa lahum min naasireen
ayahs.en: And as for those who disbelieved, I will punish them with a severe punishment in this world and the Hereafter, and they will have no helpers."

ayahs.ar: وَاَمَّا الَّذِيۡنَ اٰمَنُوۡا وَعَمِلُوا الصّٰلِحٰتِ فَيُوَفِّيۡهِمۡ اُجُوۡرَهُمۡؕ وَاللّٰهُ لَا يُحِبُّ الظّٰلِمِيۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wa ammal lazeena aamanoo wa 'amilus saalihaati fa yuwaffeehim ujoorahum; wallaahu laa yuhibbuz zaalimeen
ayahs.en: But as for those who believed and did righteous deeds, He will give them in full their rewards, and Allah does not like the wrongdoers.

ayahs.ar: ذٰلِكَ نَتۡلُوۡهُ عَلَيۡكَ مِنَ الۡاٰيٰتِ وَالذِّكۡرِ الۡحَكِيۡمِ
ayahs.tl: Zaalika natloohu 'alaika minal Aayaati wa Zikril Hakeem
ayahs.en: This is what We recite to you, [O Muhammad], of [Our] verses and the precise [and wise] message.

ayahs.ar: اِنَّ مَثَلَ عِيۡسٰي عِنۡدَ اللّٰهِ كَمَثَلِ اٰدَمَؕ خَلَقَهٗ مِنۡ تُرَابٍ ثُمَّ قَالَ لَهٗ كُنۡ فَيَكُوۡنُ
ayahs.tl: Inna masala 'Eesaa 'indal laahi kamasali Aadama khalaqahoo min turaabin summa qaala lahoo kun fayakoon
ayahs.en: Indeed, the example of Jesus to Allah is like that of Adam. He created Him from dust; then He said to him, "Be," and he was.

ayahs.ar: اَلۡحَقُّ مِنۡ رَّبِّكَ فَلَا تَكُنۡ مِّنَ الۡمُمۡتَرِيۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Alhaqqu mir Rabbika falaa takum minal mumtareen
ayahs.en: The truth is from your Lord, so do not be among the doubters.

ayahs.ar: فَمَنۡ حَآجَّكَ فِيۡهِ مِنۭۡ بَعۡدِ مَا جَآءَكَ مِنَ الۡعِلۡمِ فَقُلۡ تَعَالَوۡا نَدۡعُ اَبۡنَآءَنَا وَاَبۡنَآءَكُمۡ وَنِسَآءَنَا وَنِسَآءَكُمۡ وَاَنۡفُسَنَا وَاَنۡفُسَكُمۡࣞ ثُمَّ نَبۡتَهِلۡ فَنَجۡعَلۡ لَّعۡنَتَ اللّٰهِ عَلَي الۡكٰذِبِيۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Faman haaajjaka feehi mim ba'di maa jaaa'aka minal 'ilmi faqul ta'aalaw nad'u abnaaa'anaa wa abnaaa'akum wa nisaaa'anaa wa nisaaa'akum wa anfusanaa wa anfusakum summa nabtahil fanaj'al la'natal laahi 'alal kaazibeen
ayahs.en: Then whoever argues with you about it after [this] knowledge has come to you - say, "Come, let us call our sons and your sons, our women and your women, ourselves and yourselves, then supplicate earnestly [together] and invoke the curse of Allah upon the liars [among us]."

ayahs.ar: اِنَّ هٰذَا لَهُوَ الۡقَصَصُ الۡحَقُّۚ وَمَا مِنۡ اِلٰهٍ اِلَّا اللّٰهُؕ وَاِنَّ اللّٰهَ لَهُوَ الۡعَزِيۡزُ الۡحَكِيۡمُ
ayahs.tl: Innaa haazaa lahuwal qasasul haqq; wa maa min ilaahin illal laah; wa innal laahaa la Huwal 'Azeezul Hakeem
ayahs.en: Indeed, this is the true narration. And there is no deity except Allah. And indeed, Allah is the Exalted in Might, the Wise.

ayahs.ar: فَاِنۡ تَوَلَّوۡا فَاِنَّ اللّٰهَ عَلِيۡمٌۭ بِالۡمُفۡسِدِيۡنَࣖ‏
ayahs.tl: Fa in tawallaw fa innal laaha'aleemun bil mufsideen
ayahs.en: But if they turn away, then indeed - Allah is Knowing of the corrupters.

ayahs.ar: قُلۡ يٰ٘اَهۡلَ الۡكِتٰبِ تَعَالَوۡا اِلٰي كَلِمَةٍ سَوَآءٍۭ بَيۡنَنَا وَبَيۡنَكُمۡ اَلَّا نَعۡبُدَ اِلَّا اللّٰهَ وَلَا نُشۡرِكَ بِهٖ شَيۡـًٔا وَّلَا يَتَّخِذَ بَعۡضُنَا بَعۡضًا اَرۡبَابًا مِّنۡ دُوۡنِ اللّٰهِؕ فَاِنۡ تَوَلَّوۡا فَقُوۡلُوا اشۡهَدُوۡا بِاَنَّا مُسۡلِمُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Qul yaa Ahlal Kitaabi ta'aalaw ilaa Kalimatin sawaaa'im bainanaa wa bainakum allaa na'buda illal laaha wa laa nushrika bihee shai'anw wa laa yattakhiza ba'dunaa ba'dan arbaabam min doonil laah; fa in tawallaw faqoolush hadoo bi annaa muslimoon
ayahs.en: Say, "O People of the Scripture, come to a word that is equitable between us and you - that we will not worship except Allah and not associate anything with Him and not take one another as lords instead of Allah." But if they turn away, then say, "Bear witness that we are Muslims [submitting to Him]."

ayahs.ar: يٰ٘اَهۡلَ الۡكِتٰبِ لِمَ تُحَآجُّوۡنَ فِيۡ٘ اِبۡرٰهِيۡمَ وَمَا٘ اُنۡزِلَتِ التَّوۡرٰىةُ وَالۡاِنۡجِيۡلُ اِلَّا مِنۭۡ بَعۡدِهٖؕ اَفَلَا تَعۡقِلُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Yaaa Ahlal Kitaabi limaa tuhaaajjoona feee Ibraaheema wa maaa unzilatit Tawraatu wal Injeelu illaa mim ba'dih; afala ta'qiloon
ayahs.en: O People of the Scripture, why do you argue about Abraham while the Torah and the Gospel were not revealed until after him? Then will you not reason?

ayahs.ar: هٰ٘اَنۡتُمۡ هٰ٘ؤُلَآءِ حَاجَجۡتُمۡ فِيۡمَا لَكُمۡ بِهٖ عِلۡمٌ فَلِمَ تُحَآجُّوۡنَ فِيۡمَا لَيۡسَ لَكُمۡ بِهٖ عِلۡمٌؕ وَاللّٰهُ يَعۡلَمُ وَاَنۡتُمۡ لَا تَعۡلَمُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Haaa antum haaa'ulaaa'i baajajtum feemaa lakum bihee 'ilmun falima tuhaaajjoonaa feemaa laisa lakum bihee 'ilm; wallaahu ya'lamu wa antum laa ta'lamoon
ayahs.en: Here you are - those who have argued about that of which you have [some] knowledge, but why do you argue about that of which you have no knowledge? And Allah knows, while you know not.

ayahs.ar: مَا كَانَ اِبۡرٰهِيۡمُ يَهُوۡدِيًّا وَّلَا نَصۡرَانِيًّا وَّلٰكِنۡ كَانَ حَنِيۡفًا مُّسۡلِمًاؕ وَمَا كَانَ مِنَ الۡمُشۡرِكِيۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Maa kaana Ibraaheemu Yahoodiyyanw wa laa Nasraa niyyanw wa laakin kaana Haneefam Muslimanw wa maa kaana minal mushrikeen
ayahs.en: Abraham was neither a Jew nor a Christian, but he was one inclining toward truth, a Muslim [submitting to Allah]. And he was not of the polytheists.

ayahs.ar: اِنَّ اَوۡلَي النَّاسِ بِاِبۡرٰهِيۡمَ لَلَّذِيۡنَ اتَّبَعُوۡهُ وَهٰذَا النَّبِيُّ وَالَّذِيۡنَ اٰمَنُوۡاؕ وَاللّٰهُ وَلِيُّ الۡمُؤۡمِنِيۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Innaa awlan naasi bi Ibraaheema lallazeenat taba 'oohu wa haazan nabiyyu wallazeena aamanoo; wallaahu waliyyul mu'mineen
ayahs.en: Indeed, the most worthy of Abraham among the people are those who followed him [in submission to Allah] and this prophet, and those who believe [in his message]. And Allah is the ally of the believers.

ayahs.ar: وَدَّتۡ طَّآئِفَةٌ مِّنۡ اَهۡلِ الۡكِتٰبِ لَوۡ يُضِلُّوۡنَكُمۡؕ وَمَا يُضِلُّوۡنَ اِلَّا٘ اَنۡفُسَهُمۡ وَمَا يَشۡعُرُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Waddat taaa'ifatum min Ahlil Kitaabi law yudil loonakum wa maa yudilloona illaaa anfusahum wa maa yash'uroon
ayahs.en: A faction of the people of the Scripture wish they could mislead you. But they do not mislead except themselves, and they perceive [it] not.

ayahs.ar: يٰ٘اَهۡلَ الۡكِتٰبِ لِمَ تَكۡفُرُوۡنَ بِاٰيٰتِ اللّٰهِ وَاَنۡتُمۡ تَشۡهَدُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Yaaa Ahlal Kitaabi lima takfuroona bi Aayaatil laahi wan antum tashadoon
ayahs.en: O People of the Scripture, why do you disbelieve in the verses of Allah while you witness [to their truth]?

ayahs.ar: يٰ٘اَهۡلَ الۡكِتٰبِ لِمَ تَلۡبِسُوۡنَ الۡحَقَّ بِالۡبَاطِلِ وَتَكۡتُمُوۡنَ الۡحَقَّ وَاَنۡتُمۡ تَعۡلَمُوۡنَࣖ‏
ayahs.tl: Yaaa Ahalal Kitaabi lima talbisoonal haqqa bilbaatili wa taktumoonal haqqa wa antum ta'lamoon
ayahs.en: O People of the Scripture, why do you confuse the truth with falsehood and conceal the truth while you know [it]?

ayahs.ar: وَقَالَتۡ طَّآئِفَةٌ مِّنۡ اَهۡلِ الۡكِتٰبِ اٰمِنُوۡا بِالَّذِيۡ٘ اُنۡزِلَ عَلَي الَّذِيۡنَ اٰمَنُوۡا وَجۡهَ النَّهَارِ وَاكۡفُرُوۡ٘ا اٰخِرَهٗ لَعَلَّهُمۡ يَرۡجِعُوۡنَۚۖ‏
ayahs.tl: Wa qaalat taaa'ifatum min Ahlil Kitaabi aaminoo billazeee unzila 'alal lazeena aamanoo wajhan nahaari wakfurooo aakhirahoo la'alla hum yarji'oon
ayahs.en: And a faction of the People of the Scripture say [to each other], "Believe in that which was revealed to the believers at the beginning of the day and reject it at its end that perhaps they will abandon their religion,

ayahs.ar: وَلَا تُؤۡمِنُوۡ٘ا اِلَّا لِمَنۡ تَبِعَ دِيۡنَكُمۡؕ قُلۡ اِنَّ الۡهُدٰي هُدَي اللّٰهِۙ اَنۡ يُّؤۡتٰ٘ي اَحَدٌ مِّثۡلَ مَا٘ اُوۡتِيۡتُمۡ اَوۡ يُحَآجُّوۡكُمۡ عِنۡدَ رَبِّكُمۡؕ قُلۡ اِنَّ الۡفَضۡلَ بِيَدِ اللّٰهِۚ يُؤۡتِيۡهِ مَنۡ يَّشَآءُؕ وَاللّٰهُ وَاسِعٌ عَلِيۡمٌۚۙ‏
ayahs.tl: Wa laa tu'minooo illaa liman tabi'a deenakum qul innal hudaa hudal laahi ai yu'taaa ahadum misla maaa ooteetum aw yuhaaajjookum 'inda Rabbikum, qul innal fadla biyadil laah; yu'teehi mai yashaaa'; wallaahu Waasi'un 'Aleem
ayahs.en: And do not trust except those who follow your religion." Say, "Indeed, the [true] guidance is the guidance of Allah. [Do you fear] lest someone be given [knowledge] like you were given or that they would [thereby] argue with you before your Lord?" Say, "Indeed, [all] bounty is in the hand of Allah - He grants it to whom He wills. And Allah is all-Encompassing and Wise."

ayahs.ar: يَّخۡتَصُّ بِرَحۡمَتِهٖ مَنۡ يَّشَآءُؕ وَاللّٰهُ ذُو الۡفَضۡلِ الۡعَظِيۡمِ
ayahs.tl: Yakhtassu birahmatihee mai yashaaa'; wallaahu zulfadil 'azeem
ayahs.en: He selects for His mercy whom He wills. And Allah is the possessor of great bounty.

ayahs.ar: وَمِنۡ اَهۡلِ الۡكِتٰبِ مَنۡ اِنۡ تَاۡمَنۡهُ بِقِنۡطَارٍ يُّؤَدِّهٖ٘ اِلَيۡكَۚ وَمِنۡهُمۡ مَّنۡ اِنۡ تَاۡمَنۡهُ بِدِيۡنَارٍ لَّا يُؤَدِّهٖ٘ اِلَيۡكَ اِلَّا مَا دُمۡتَ عَلَيۡهِ قَآئِمًاؕ ذٰلِكَ بِاَنَّهُمۡ قَالُوۡا لَيۡسَ عَلَيۡنَا فِي الۡاُمِّيّٖنَ سَبِيۡلٌۚ وَيَقُوۡلُوۡنَ عَلَي اللّٰهِ الۡكَذِبَ وَهُمۡ يَعۡلَمُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wa min Ahlil Kitaabi man in taamanhu biqintaariny yu'addihee ilaika wa minhum man in taamanhu bideenaaril laa yu'addiheee ilaika illaa maa dumta 'alaihi qaaa' imaa; zaalika biannahum qaaloo laisa 'alainaa fil ummiyyeena sabeelunw wa yaqooloona 'alal laahil kaziba wa hum ya'lamoon
ayahs.en: And among the People of the Scripture is he who, if you entrust him with a great amount [of wealth], he will return it to you. And among them is he who, if you entrust him with a [single] silver coin, he will not return it to you unless you are constantly standing over him [demanding it]. That is because they say, "There is no blame upon us concerning the unlearned." And they speak untruth about Allah while they know [it].

ayahs.ar: بَلٰي مَنۡ اَوۡفٰي بِعَهۡدِهٖ وَاتَّقٰي فَاِنَّ اللّٰهَ يُحِبُّ الۡمُتَّقِيۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Balaa man awfaa bi'ahdihee wattaqaa fainnal laaha yuhibbul muttaqeen
ayahs.en: But yes, whoever fulfills his commitment and fears Allah - then indeed, Allah loves those who fear Him.

ayahs.ar: اِنَّ الَّذِيۡنَ يَشۡتَرُوۡنَ بِعَهۡدِ اللّٰهِ وَاَيۡمَانِهِمۡ ثَمَنًا قَلِيۡلًا اُولٰٓئِكَ لَا خَلَاقَ لَهُمۡ فِي الۡاٰخِرَةِ وَلَا يُكَلِّمُهُمُ اللّٰهُ وَلَا يَنۡظُرُ اِلَيۡهِمۡ يَوۡمَ الۡقِيٰمَةِ وَلَا يُزَكِّيۡهِمۡࣕ وَلَهُمۡ عَذَابٌ اَلِيۡمٌ
ayahs.tl: Innal lazeena yashtaroona bi'ahdil laahi wa aymaanihim samanan qaleelan ulaaa'ika laa khalaaqa lahum fil Aakhirati wa laa yukallimuhumul laahu wa laa yanzuru ilaihim Yawmal Qiyaamati wa laa yuzakkeehim wa lahum 'azabun 'aleem
ayahs.en: Indeed, those who exchange the covenant of Allah and their [own] oaths for a small price will have no share in the Hereafter, and Allah will not speak to them or look at them on the Day of Resurrection, nor will He purify them; and they will have a painful punishment.

ayahs.ar: وَاِنَّ مِنۡهُمۡ لَفَرِيۡقًا يَّلۡوٗنَ اَلۡسِنَتَهُمۡ بِالۡكِتٰبِ لِتَحۡسَبُوۡهُ مِنَ الۡكِتٰبِ وَمَا هُوَ مِنَ الۡكِتٰبِۚ وَيَقُوۡلُوۡنَ هُوَ مِنۡ عِنۡدِ اللّٰهِ وَمَا هُوَ مِنۡ عِنۡدِ اللّٰهِۚ وَيَقُوۡلُوۡنَ عَلَي اللّٰهِ الۡكَذِبَ وَهُمۡ يَعۡلَمُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wa inna minhum lafaree qany yalwoona alsinatahum bil Kitaabi litahsaboohu minal Kitaab, wa maa huwa minal Kitaabi wa yaqooloon huwa min 'indillaahi wa maa huwa min 'indillaahi wa yaqooloona 'alal laahil kaziba wa hum ya'lamoon
ayahs.en: And indeed, there is among them a party who alter the Scripture with their tongues so you may think it is from the Scripture, but it is not from the Scripture. And they say, "This is from Allah," but it is not from Allah. And they speak untruth about Allah while they know.

ayahs.ar: مَا كَانَ لِبَشَرٍ اَنۡ يُّؤۡتِيَهُ اللّٰهُ الۡكِتٰبَ وَالۡحُكۡمَ وَالنُّبُوَّةَ ثُمَّ يَقُوۡلَ لِلنَّاسِ كُوۡنُوۡا عِبَادًا لِّيۡ مِنۡ دُوۡنِ اللّٰهِ وَلٰكِنۡ كُوۡنُوۡا رَبّٰنِيّٖنَ بِمَا كُنۡتُمۡ تُعَلِّمُوۡنَ الۡكِتٰبَ وَبِمَا كُنۡتُمۡ تَدۡرُسُوۡنَۙ‏
ayahs.tl: Maa kaana libasharin ai yu'tiyahul laahul Kitaaba walhukma wan Nubuwwata summa yaqoola linnaasi koonoo 'ibaadal lee min doonil laahi wa laakin koonoo rabbaaniy yeena bimaa kuntum tu'allimoonal Kitaaba wa bimaa kuntum tadrusoon
ayahs.en: It is not for a human [prophet] that Allah should give him the Scripture and authority and prophethood and then he would say to the people, "Be servants to me rather than Allah," but [instead, he would say], "Be pious scholars of the Lord because of what you have taught of the Scripture and because of what you have studied."

ayahs.ar: وَلَا يَاۡمُرَكُمۡ اَنۡ تَتَّخِذُوا الۡمَلٰٓئِكَةَ وَالنَّبِيّٖنَ اَرۡبَابًاؕ اَيَاۡمُرُكُمۡ بِالۡكُفۡرِ بَعۡدَ اِذۡ اَنۡتُمۡ مُّسۡلِمُوۡنَࣖ‏
ayahs.tl: Wa laa yaamurakum an tattakhizul malaaa 'ikata wan Nabiyyeena arbaabaa; a yaamurukum bilkufri ba'da iz antum muslimoon
ayahs.en: Nor could he order you to take the angels and prophets as lords. Would he order you to disbelief after you had been Muslims?

ayahs.ar: وَاِذۡ اَخَذَ اللّٰهُ مِيۡثَاقَ النَّبِيّٖنَ لَمَا٘ اٰتَيۡتُكُمۡ مِّنۡ كِتٰبٍ وَّحِكۡمَةٍ ثُمَّ جَآءَكُمۡ رَسُوۡلٌ مُّصَدِّقٌ لِّمَا مَعَكُمۡ لَتُؤۡمِنُنَّ بِهٖ وَلَتَنۡصُرُنَّهٗؕ قَالَ ءَاَقۡرَرۡتُمۡ وَاَخَذۡتُمۡ عَلٰي ذٰلِكُمۡ اِصۡرِيۡؕ قَالُوۡ٘ا اَقۡرَرۡنَاؕ قَالَ فَاشۡهَدُوۡا وَاَنَا مَعَكُمۡ مِّنَ الشّٰهِدِيۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wa iz akhazal laahu meesaaqan Nabiyyeena lamaaa aataitukum min Kitaabinw wa Hikmatin summa jaaa'akum Rasoolum musaddiqul limaa ma'akum latu'minunna bihee wa latansurunnah; qaala 'aaqrartum wa akhaztum alaa zaalikum isree qaalooo aqrarnaa; qaala fashhadoo wa ana ma'akum minash shaahideen
ayahs.en: And [recall, O People of the Scripture], when Allah took the covenant of the prophets, [saying], "Whatever I give you of the Scripture and wisdom and then there comes to you a messenger confirming what is with you, you [must] believe in him and support him." [Allah] said, "Have you acknowledged and taken upon that My commitment?" They said, "We have acknowledged it." He said, "Then bear witness, and I am with you among the witnesses."

ayahs.ar: فَمَنۡ تَوَلّٰي بَعۡدَ ذٰلِكَ فَاُولٰٓئِكَ هُمُ الۡفٰسِقُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Faman tawallaa ba'da zaalika fa ulaaa'ika humul faasiqoon
ayahs.en: And whoever turned away after that - they were the defiantly disobedient.

ayahs.ar: اَفَغَيۡرَ دِيۡنِ اللّٰهِ يَبۡغُوۡنَ وَلَهٗ٘ اَسۡلَمَ مَنۡ فِي السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالۡاَرۡضِ طَوۡعًا وَّكَرۡهًا وَّاِلَيۡهِ يُرۡجَعُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Afaghaira deenil laahi yabghoona wa lahooo aslama man fis samaawaati wal ardi taw'anw wa karhanw wa ilaihi yurja'oon
ayahs.en: So is it other than the religion of Allah they desire, while to Him have submitted [all] those within the heavens and earth, willingly or by compulsion, and to Him they will be returned?

ayahs.ar: قُلۡ اٰمَنَّا بِاللّٰهِ وَمَا٘ اُنۡزِلَ عَلَيۡنَا وَمَا٘ اُنۡزِلَ عَلٰ٘ي اِبۡرٰهِيۡمَ وَاِسۡمٰعِيۡلَ وَاِسۡحٰقَ وَيَعۡقُوۡبَ وَالۡاَسۡبَاطِ وَمَا٘ اُوۡتِيَ مُوۡسٰي وَعِيۡسٰي وَالنَّبِيُّوۡنَ مِنۡ رَّبِّهِمۡࣕ لَا نُفَرِّقُ بَيۡنَ اَحَدٍ مِّنۡهُمۡؗ وَنَحۡنُ لَهٗ مُسۡلِمُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Qul aamannaa billaahi wa maaa unzila 'alainaa wa maaa unzila 'alaaa Ibraaheema wa Ismaa'eela wa Ishaaqa wa Ya'qooba wal Asbaati wa maaa ootiya Moosaa wa 'Eesaa wan Nabiyyoona mir Rabbihim laa nufarriqu baina ahadim minhum wa nahnu lahoo muslimoon
ayahs.en: Say, "We have believed in Allah and in what was revealed to us and what was revealed to Abraham, Ishmael, Isaac, Jacob, and the Descendants, and in what was given to Moses and Jesus and to the prophets from their Lord. We make no distinction between any of them, and we are Muslims [submitting] to Him."

ayahs.ar: وَمَنۡ يَّبۡتَغِ غَيۡرَ الۡاِسۡلَامِ دِيۡنًا فَلَنۡ يُّقۡبَلَ مِنۡهُۚ وَهُوَ فِي الۡاٰخِرَةِ مِنَ الۡخٰسِرِيۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wa mai yabtaghi ghairal Islaami deenan falany yuqbala minhu wa huwa fil Aakhirati minal khaasireen
ayahs.en: And whoever desires other than Islam as religion - never will it be accepted from him, and he, in the Hereafter, will be among the losers.

ayahs.ar: كَيۡفَ يَهۡدِي اللّٰهُ قَوۡمًا كَفَرُوۡا بَعۡدَ اِيۡمَانِهِمۡ وَشَهِدُوۡ٘ا اَنَّ الرَّسُوۡلَ حَقٌّ وَّجَآءَهُمُ الۡبَيِّنٰتُؕ وَاللّٰهُ لَا يَهۡدِي الۡقَوۡمَ الظّٰلِمِيۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Kaifa yahdil laahu qawman kafaroo ba'da eemaanihim wa shahidooo annar Rasoola haqqunw wa jaaa'ahumul baiyinaat; wallaahu laa yahdil qawmaz zaalimeen
ayahs.en: How shall Allah guide a people who disbelieved after their belief and had witnessed that the Messenger is true and clear signs had come to them? And Allah does not guide the wrongdoing people.

ayahs.ar: اُولٰٓئِكَ جَزَآؤُهُمۡ اَنَّ عَلَيۡهِمۡ لَعۡنَةَ اللّٰهِ وَالۡمَلٰٓئِكَةِ وَالنَّاسِ اَجۡمَعِيۡنَۙ‏
ayahs.tl: Ulaaa'ika jazaaa'uhum anna 'alaihim la'natal laahi walmalaaa'ikati wannaasi ajma'een
ayahs.en: Those - their recompense will be that upon them is the curse of Allah and the angels and the people, all together,

ayahs.ar: خٰلِدِيۡنَ فِيۡهَاۚ لَا يُخَفَّفُ عَنۡهُمُ الۡعَذَابُ وَلَا هُمۡ يُنۡظَرُوۡنَۙ‏
ayahs.tl: Khaalideena feehaa laa yukhaffafu 'anhumul 'azaabu wa laa hum yunzaroon
ayahs.en: Abiding eternally therein. The punishment will not be lightened for them, nor will they be reprieved.

ayahs.ar: اِلَّا الَّذِيۡنَ تَابُوۡا مِنۭۡ بَعۡدِ ذٰلِكَ وَاَصۡلَحُوۡاࣞ فَاِنَّ اللّٰهَ غَفُوۡرٌ رَّحِيۡمٌ
ayahs.tl: Illal lazeena taaboo mim ba'di zaalika wa aslahoo fa innal laaha Ghafoorur Raheem
ayahs.en: Except for those who repent after that and correct themselves. For indeed, Allah is Forgiving and Merciful.

ayahs.ar: اِنَّ الَّذِيۡنَ كَفَرُوۡا بَعۡدَ اِيۡمَانِهِمۡ ثُمَّ ازۡدَادُوۡا كُفۡرًا لَّنۡ تُقۡبَلَ تَوۡبَتُهُمۡۚ وَاُولٰٓئِكَ هُمُ الضَّآلُّوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Innal lazeena kafaroo ba'da eemaanihim summaz daadoo kufral lan tuqbala tawbatuhum wa ulaaa'ika humud daaalloon
ayahs.en: Indeed, those who reject the message after their belief and then increase in disbelief - never will their [claimed] repentance be accepted, and they are the ones astray.

ayahs.ar: اِنَّ الَّذِيۡنَ كَفَرُوۡا وَمَاتُوۡا وَهُمۡ كُفَّارٌ فَلَنۡ يُّقۡبَلَ مِنۡ اَحَدِهِمۡ مِّلۡءُ الۡاَرۡضِ ذَهَبًا وَّلَوِ افۡتَدٰي بِهٖؕ اُولٰٓئِكَ لَهُمۡ عَذَابٌ اَلِيۡمٌۙ وَّمَا لَهُمۡ مِّنۡ نّٰصِرِيۡنَࣖ‏
ayahs.tl: Innal lazeena kafaroo wa maatoo wa hum kuffaarun falany yuqbala min ahadihim mil'ul ardi zahabanw wa lawiftadaa bih; ulaaa 'ika lahum 'azaabun aleemunw wa maa lahum min naasireen
ayahs.en: Indeed, those who disbelieve and die while they are disbelievers - never would the [whole] capacity of the earth in gold be accepted from one of them if he would [seek to] ransom himself with it. For those there will be a painful punishment, and they will have no helpers.

ayahs.ar: لَنۡ تَنَالُوا الۡبِرَّ حَتّٰي تُنۡفِقُوۡا مِمَّا تُحِبُّوۡنَ ࣢ؕ وَمَا تُنۡفِقُوۡا مِنۡ شَيۡءٍ فَاِنَّ اللّٰهَ بِهٖ عَلِيۡمٌ
ayahs.tl: Lan tanaalul birra hattaa tunfiqoo mimmaa tuhibboon; wa maa tunfiqoo min shai'in fa innal laaha bihee 'Aleem
ayahs.en: Never will you attain the good [reward] until you spend [in the way of Allah] from that which you love. And whatever you spend - indeed, Allah is Knowing of it.

ayahs.ar: كُلُّ الطَّعَامِ كَانَ حِلًّا لِّبَنِيۡ٘ اِسۡرَآءِيۡلَ اِلَّا مَا حَرَّمَ اِسۡرَآءِيۡلُ عَلٰي نَفۡسِهٖ مِنۡ قَبۡلِ اَنۡ تُنَزَّلَ التَّوۡرٰىةُؕ قُلۡ فَاۡتُوۡا بِالتَّوۡرٰىةِ فَاتۡلُوۡهَا٘ اِنۡ كُنۡتُمۡ صٰدِقِيۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Kullut ta'aami kaana hillal li Baneee Israaa'eela illaa maa harrama Israaa'eelu 'alaa nafsihee min qabli an tunzzalat Tawraah; qul faatoo bit Tawraati fatloohaaa in kuntum saadiqeen
ayahs.en: All food was lawful to the Children of Israel except what Israel had made unlawful to himself before the Torah was revealed. Say, [O Muhammad], "So bring the Torah and recite it, if you should be truthful."

ayahs.ar: فَمَنِ افۡتَرٰي عَلَي اللّٰهِ الۡكَذِبَ مِنۭۡ بَعۡدِ ذٰلِكَ فَاُولٰٓئِكَ هُمُ الظّٰلِمُوۡنَؔ‏
ayahs.tl: Famanif taraa 'alal laahilkaziba mim ba'di zaalika fa ulaaa'ika humuz zaalimoon
ayahs.en: And whoever invents about Allah untruth after that - then those are [truly] the wrongdoers.

ayahs.ar: قُلۡ صَدَقَ اللّٰهُࣞ فَاتَّبِعُوۡا مِلَّةَ اِبۡرٰهِيۡمَ حَنِيۡفًاؕ وَمَا كَانَ مِنَ الۡمُشۡرِكِيۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Qul sadaqal laah; fattabi'oo Millata Ibraaheema Haneefanw wa maa kaana minal mush rikeen
ayahs.en: Say, "Allah has told the truth. So follow the religion of Abraham, inclining toward truth; and he was not of the polytheists."

ayahs.ar: اِنَّ اَوَّلَ بَيۡتٍ وُّضِعَ لِلنَّاسِ لَلَّذِيۡ بِبَكَّةَ مُبٰرَكًا وَّهُدًي لِّلۡعٰلَمِيۡنَۚ‏
ayahs.tl: Inna awwala Baitinw wudi'a linnaasi lallazee bi Bakkata mubaarakanw wa hudal lil 'aalameen
ayahs.en: Indeed, the first House [of worship] established for mankind was that at Makkah - blessed and a guidance for the worlds.

ayahs.ar: فِيۡهِ اٰيٰتٌۭ بَيِّنٰتٌ مَّقَامُ اِبۡرٰهِيۡمَ ࣢ۚ وَمَنۡ دَخَلَهٗ كَانَ اٰمِنًاؕ وَلِلّٰهِ عَلَي النَّاسِ حِجُّ الۡبَيۡتِ مَنِ اسۡتَطَاعَ اِلَيۡهِ سَبِيۡلًاؕ وَمَنۡ كَفَرَ فَاِنَّ اللّٰهَ غَنِيٌّ عَنِ الۡعٰلَمِيۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Feehi Aayaatum baiyinaatum Maqaamu Ibraaheema wa man dakhalahoo kaana aaminaa; wa lillaahi 'alan naasi Hijjul Baiti manis tataa'a ilaihi sabeelaa; wa man kafara fa innal laaha ghaniyyun 'anil 'aalameen
ayahs.en: In it are clear signs [such as] the standing place of Abraham. And whoever enters it shall be safe. And [due] to Allah from the people is a pilgrimage to the House - for whoever is able to find thereto a way. But whoever disbelieves - then indeed, Allah is free from need of the worlds.

ayahs.ar: قُلۡ يٰ٘اَهۡلَ الۡكِتٰبِ لِمَ تَكۡفُرُوۡنَ بِاٰيٰتِ اللّٰهِࣗۖ وَاللّٰهُ شَهِيۡدٌ عَلٰي مَا تَعۡمَلُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Qul yaaa Ahlal Kitaabi lima takfuroona bi Aayaatillaahi wallaahu shaheedun 'alaa maa ta'maloon
ayahs.en: Say, "O People of the Scripture, why do you disbelieve in the verses of Allah while Allah is Witness over what you do?"

ayahs.ar: قُلۡ يٰ٘اَهۡلَ الۡكِتٰبِ لِمَ تَصُدُّوۡنَ عَنۡ سَبِيۡلِ اللّٰهِ مَنۡ اٰمَنَ تَبۡغُوۡنَهَا عِوَجًا وَّاَنۡتُمۡ شُهَدَآءُؕ وَمَا اللّٰهُ بِغَافِلٍ عَمَّا تَعۡمَلُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Qul yaaa Ahlal Kitaabi lima tusuddoona 'an sabeelil laahi man aamana tabghoonahaa 'iwajanw wa antum shuhadaaa'; wa mallaahu bighaafilin 'ammaa ta'maloon
ayahs.en: Say, "O People of the Scripture, why do you avert from the way of Allah those who believe, seeking to make it [seem] deviant, while you are witnesses [to the truth]? And Allah is not unaware of what you do."

ayahs.ar: يٰ٘اَيُّهَا الَّذِيۡنَ اٰمَنُوۡ٘ا اِنۡ تُطِيۡعُوۡا فَرِيۡقًا مِّنَ الَّذِيۡنَ اُوۡتُوا الۡكِتٰبَ يَرُدُّوۡكُمۡ بَعۡدَ اِيۡمَانِكُمۡ كٰفِرِيۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Yaaa ayyuhal lazeena aamanoo in tutee'oo fareeqam minal lazeena ootul Kitaaba yaruddookum ba'da eemaanikum kaafireen
ayahs.en: O you who have believed, if you obey a party of those who were given the Scripture, they would turn you back, after your belief, [to being] unbelievers.

ayahs.ar: وَكَيۡفَ تَكۡفُرُوۡنَ وَاَنۡتُمۡ تُتۡلٰي عَلَيۡكُمۡ اٰيٰتُ اللّٰهِ وَفِيۡكُمۡ رَسُوۡلُهٗؕ وَمَنۡ يَّعۡتَصِمۡ بِاللّٰهِ فَقَدۡ هُدِيَ اِلٰي صِرَاطٍ مُّسۡتَقِيۡمٍࣖ‏
ayahs.tl: Wa kaifa takfuroona wa antum tutlaa 'alaikum Aayaatul laahi wa feekum Rasooluh; wa mai ya'tasim baillaahi faqad hudiya ilaa Siraatim Mustaqeem
ayahs.en: And how could you disbelieve while to you are being recited the verses of Allah and among you is His Messenger? And whoever holds firmly to Allah has [indeed] been guided to a straight path.

ayahs.ar: يٰ٘اَيُّهَا الَّذِيۡنَ اٰمَنُوا اتَّقُوا اللّٰهَ حَقَّ تُقٰتِهٖ وَلَا تَمُوۡتُنَّ اِلَّا وَاَنۡتُمۡ مُّسۡلِمُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Yaaa ayyuhal lazeena aamanut taqul laaha haqqa tuqaatihee wa laa tamoontunna illaa wa antum muslimoon
ayahs.en: O you who have believed, fear Allah as He should be feared and do not die except as Muslims [in submission to Him].

ayahs.ar: وَاعۡتَصِمُوۡا بِحَبۡلِ اللّٰهِ جَمِيۡعًا وَّلَا تَفَرَّقُوۡاࣕ وَاذۡكُرُوۡا نِعۡمَتَ اللّٰهِ عَلَيۡكُمۡ اِذۡ كُنۡتُمۡ اَعۡدَآءً فَاَلَّفَ بَيۡنَ قُلُوۡبِكُمۡ فَاَصۡبَحۡتُمۡ بِنِعۡمَتِهٖ٘ اِخۡوَانًاۚ وَكُنۡتُمۡ عَلٰي شَفَا حُفۡرَةٍ مِّنَ النَّارِ فَاَنۡقَذَكُمۡ مِّنۡهَاؕ كَذٰلِكَ يُبَيِّنُ اللّٰهُ لَكُمۡ اٰيٰتِهٖ لَعَلَّكُمۡ تَهۡتَدُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wa'tasimoo bi Hablil laahi jamee'anw wa laa tafarraqoo; wazkuroo ni'matal laahi alaikum iz kuntum a'daaa'an fa allafa baina quloobikum fa asbah tum bini'matiheee ikhwaananw wa kuntum 'alaa shafaa hufratim minan Naari fa anqazakum minhaa; kazaalika yubaiyinul laahu lakum aayaatihee la'allakum tahtadoon
ayahs.en: And hold firmly to the rope of Allah all together and do not become divided. And remember the favor of Allah upon you - when you were enemies and He brought your hearts together and you became, by His favor, brothers. And you were on the edge of a pit of the Fire, and He saved you from it. Thus does Allah make clear to you His verses that you may be guided.

ayahs.ar: وَلۡتَكُنۡ مِّنۡكُمۡ اُمَّةٌ يَّدۡعُوۡنَ اِلَي الۡخَيۡرِ وَيَاۡمُرُوۡنَ بِالۡمَعۡرُوۡفِ وَيَنۡهَوۡنَ عَنِ الۡمُنۡكَرِؕ وَاُولٰٓئِكَ هُمُ الۡمُفۡلِحُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Waltakum minkum ummatuny yad'oona ilal khairi wa yaamuroona bilma 'roofi wa yanhawna 'anil munkar; wa ulaaa'ika humul muflihoon
ayahs.en: And let there be [arising] from you a nation inviting to [all that is] good, enjoining what is right and forbidding what is wrong, and those will be the successful.

ayahs.ar: وَلَا تَكُوۡنُوۡا كَالَّذِيۡنَ تَفَرَّقُوۡا وَاخۡتَلَفُوۡا مِنۭۡ بَعۡدِ مَا جَآءَهُمُ الۡبَيِّنٰتُؕ وَاُولٰٓئِكَ لَهُمۡ عَذَابٌ عَظِيۡمٌۙ‏
ayahs.tl: Wa laa takoonoo kallazeena tafarraqoo wakhtalafoo mim ba'di maa jaaa'ahumul baiyinaat; wa ulaaa'ika lahum 'azaabun 'azeem
ayahs.en: And do not be like the ones who became divided and differed after the clear proofs had come to them. And those will have a great punishment.

ayahs.ar: يَّوۡمَ تَبۡيَضُّ وُجُوۡهٌ وَّتَسۡوَدُّ وُجُوۡهٌۚ فَاَمَّا الَّذِيۡنَ اسۡوَدَّتۡ وُجُوۡهُهُمۡࣞ اَكَفَرۡتُمۡ بَعۡدَ اِيۡمَانِكُمۡ فَذُوۡقُوا الۡعَذَابَ بِمَا كُنۡتُمۡ تَكۡفُرُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Yawma tabyaddu wujoohunw wa taswaddu wujooh; faammal lazeenas waddat wujoohum akafartum ba'da eemaanikum fazooqul 'azaaba bimaa kuntum takfuroon
ayahs.en: On the Day [some] faces will turn white and [some] faces will turn black. As for those whose faces turn black, [to them it will be said], "Did you disbelieve after your belief? Then taste the punishment for what you used to reject."

ayahs.ar: وَاَمَّا الَّذِيۡنَ ابۡيَضَّتۡ وُجُوۡهُهُمۡ فَفِيۡ رَحۡمَةِ اللّٰهِؕ هُمۡ فِيۡهَا خٰلِدُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wa ammal lazeenabyadd at wujoohuhum fafee rahmatil laahi hum feehaa khaalidoon
ayahs.en: But as for those whose faces will turn white, [they will be] within the mercy of Allah. They will abide therein eternally.

ayahs.ar: تِلۡكَ اٰيٰتُ اللّٰهِ نَتۡلُوۡهَا عَلَيۡكَ بِالۡحَقِّؕ وَمَا اللّٰهُ يُرِيۡدُ ظُلۡمًا لِّلۡعٰلَمِيۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Tilka Aayaatul laahi natloohaa 'alaika bilhaqq; wa mal laahu yureedu zulmallil 'aalameen
ayahs.en: These are the verses of Allah. We recite them to you, [O Muhammad], in truth; and Allah wants no injustice to the worlds.

ayahs.ar: وَلِلّٰهِ مَا فِي السَّمٰوٰتِ وَمَا فِي الۡاَرۡضِؕ وَاِلَي اللّٰهِ تُرۡجَعُ الۡاُمُوۡرُࣖ‏
ayahs.tl: Wa lillaahi maa fissamaawaati wa maa fil ard; wa ilal laahi turja;ul umoor
ayahs.en: To Allah belongs whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth. And to Allah will [all] matters be returned.

ayahs.ar: كُنۡتُمۡ خَيۡرَ اُمَّةٍ اُخۡرِجَتۡ لِلنَّاسِ تَاۡمُرُوۡنَ بِالۡمَعۡرُوۡفِ وَتَنۡهَوۡنَ عَنِ الۡمُنۡكَرِ وَتُؤۡمِنُوۡنَ بِاللّٰهِؕ وَلَوۡ اٰمَنَ اَهۡلُ الۡكِتٰبِ لَكَانَ خَيۡرًا لَّهُمۡؕ مِنۡهُمُ الۡمُؤۡمِنُوۡنَ وَاَكۡثَرُهُمُ الۡفٰسِقُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Kuntum khaira ummatin ukhrijat linnaasi taamuroona bilma'roofi wa tanhawna 'anil munkari wa tu'minoona billaah; wa law aamana Ahlul Kitaabi lakaana khairal lahum minhumul mu'minoona wa aksaruhumul faasiqoon
ayahs.en: You are the best nation produced [as an example] for mankind. You enjoin what is right and forbid what is wrong and believe in Allah. If only the People of the Scripture had believed, it would have been better for them. Among them are believers, but most of them are defiantly disobedient.

ayahs.ar: لَنۡ يَّضُرُّوۡكُمۡ اِلَّا٘ اَذًيؕ وَاِنۡ يُّقَاتِلُوۡكُمۡ يُوَلُّوۡكُمُ الۡاَدۡبَارَࣞ ثُمَّ لَا يُنۡصَرُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Lai yadurrookum 'illaaa azanw wa ai yuqaatilookum yuwallookumul adbaara summa laa yunsaroon
ayahs.en: They will not harm you except for [some] annoyance. And if they fight you, they will show you their backs; then they will not be aided.

ayahs.ar: ضُرِبَتۡ عَلَيۡهِمُ الذِّلَّةُ اَيۡنَ مَا ثُقِفُوۡ٘ا اِلَّا بِحَبۡلٍ مِّنَ اللّٰهِ وَحَبۡلٍ مِّنَ النَّاسِ وَبَآءُوۡ بِغَضَبٍ مِّنَ اللّٰهِ وَضُرِبَتۡ عَلَيۡهِمُ الۡمَسۡكَنَةُؕ ذٰلِكَ بِاَنَّهُمۡ كَانُوۡا يَكۡفُرُوۡنَ بِاٰيٰتِ اللّٰهِ وَيَقۡتُلُوۡنَ الۡاَنۭۡ بِيَآءَ بِغَيۡرِ حَقٍّؕ ذٰلِكَ بِمَا عَصَوۡا وَّكَانُوۡا يَعۡتَدُوۡنَࣗ‏
ayahs.tl: Duribat 'alaihimuz zillatu aina maa suqifooo illaa bihablim minal laahi wa hablim minan naasi wa baaa'oo bighadabim minallaahi wa duribat 'alaihimul maskanah; zaalika bi-annahum kaanoo yakfuroona bi Aayaatil laahi wa yaqtuloonal Ambiyaaa'a bighairi haqq; zaalika bimaa 'asaw wa kaanoo ya'tadoon
ayahs.en: They have been put under humiliation [by Allah] wherever they are overtaken, except for a covenant from Allah and a rope from the Muslims. And they have drawn upon themselves anger from Allah and have been put under destitution. That is because they disbelieved in the verses of Allah and killed the prophets without right. That is because they disobeyed and [habitually] transgressed.

ayahs.ar: لَيۡسُوۡا سَوَآءًؕ مِنۡ اَهۡلِ الۡكِتٰبِ اُمَّةٌ قَآئِمَةٌ يَّتۡلُوۡنَ اٰيٰتِ اللّٰهِ اٰنَآءَ الَّيۡلِ وَهُمۡ يَسۡجُدُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Laisoo sawaaa'a; min Ahlil Kitaabi ummatun qaaa'imatuny yatloona Aayaatil laahi aanaaa'al laili wa hum yasjudoon
ayahs.en: They are not [all] the same; among the People of the Scripture is a community standing [in obedience], reciting the verses of Allah during periods of the night and prostrating [in prayer].

ayahs.ar: يُؤۡمِنُوۡنَ بِاللّٰهِ وَالۡيَوۡمِ الۡاٰخِرِ وَيَاۡمُرُوۡنَ بِالۡمَعۡرُوۡفِ وَيَنۡهَوۡنَ عَنِ الۡمُنۡكَرِ وَيُسَارِعُوۡنَ فِي الۡخَيۡرٰتِؕ وَاُولٰٓئِكَ مِنَ الصّٰلِحِيۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Yu'minoona billaahi wal Yawmil Aakhiri wa yaa muroona bilma'roofi wa yanhawna 'anil munkari wa yusaari'oona fil khairaati wa ulaa'ika minas saaliheen
ayahs.en: They believe in Allah and the Last Day, and they enjoin what is right and forbid what is wrong and hasten to good deeds. And those are among the righteous.

ayahs.ar: وَمَا يَفۡعَلُوۡا مِنۡ خَيۡرٍ فَلَنۡ يُّكۡفَرُوۡهُؕ وَاللّٰهُ عَلِيۡمٌۭ بِالۡمُتَّقِيۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wa maa yaf'aloo min khairin falai yukfarooh; wallaahu 'aleemun bilmuttaqeen
ayahs.en: And whatever good they do - never will it be removed from them. And Allah is Knowing of the righteous.

ayahs.ar: اِنَّ الَّذِيۡنَ كَفَرُوۡا لَنۡ تُغۡنِيَ عَنۡهُمۡ اَمۡوَالُهُمۡ وَلَا٘ اَوۡلَادُهُمۡ مِّنَ اللّٰهِ شَيۡـًٔاؕ وَاُولٰٓئِكَ اَصۡحٰبُ النَّارِۚ هُمۡ فِيۡهَا خٰلِدُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Innal lazeena kafaroo lan tughniya 'anhum amwaalum wa laaa awlaaduhum minal laahi shai anw wa ulaaa'ika Ashaabun Naar; hum feehaa khaalidoon
ayahs.en: Indeed, those who disbelieve - never will their wealth or their children avail them against Allah at all, and those are the companions of the Fire; they will abide therein eternally.

ayahs.ar: مَثَلُ مَا يُنۡفِقُوۡنَ فِيۡ هٰذِهِ الۡحَيٰوةِ الدُّنۡيَا كَمَثَلِ رِيۡحٍ فِيۡهَا صِرٌّ اَصَابَتۡ حَرۡثَ قَوۡمٍ ظَلَمُوۡ٘ا اَنۡفُسَهُمۡ فَاَهۡلَكَتۡهُؕ وَمَا ظَلَمَهُمُ اللّٰهُ وَلٰكِنۡ اَنۡفُسَهُمۡ يَظۡلِمُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Masalu maa yunfiqoona fee haazihil hayaatid dunyaa kamasali reehin feehaa sirrun as aabat harsa qawmin zalamooo anfusahum fa ahlakath; wa maa zalamahumul laahu wa laakin anfusahum yazlimoon
ayahs.en: The example of what they spend in this worldly life is like that of a wind containing frost which strikes the harvest of a people who have wronged themselves and destroys it. And Allah has not wronged them, but they wrong themselves.

ayahs.ar: يٰ٘اَيُّهَا الَّذِيۡنَ اٰمَنُوۡا لَا تَتَّخِذُوۡا بِطَانَةً مِّنۡ دُوۡنِكُمۡ لَا يَاۡلُوۡنَكُمۡ خَبَالًاؕ وَدُّوۡا مَا عَنِتُّمۡۚ قَدۡ بَدَتِ الۡبَغۡضَآءُ مِنۡ اَفۡوَاهِهِمۡۚۖ وَمَا تُخۡفِيۡ صُدُوۡرُهُمۡ اَكۡبَرُؕ قَدۡ بَيَّنَّا لَكُمُ الۡاٰيٰتِ اِنۡ كُنۡتُمۡ تَعۡقِلُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Yaaa ayyuhal lazeena aamanoo laa tattakhizoo bitaanatam min doonikum laa yaaloonakum khabaalanw waddoo maa 'anittum qad badatil baghdaaa'u min afwaahihim; wa maa tukhfee sudooruhum akbar; qad baiyannaa lakumul Aayaati in kuntum ta'qiloon
ayahs.en: O you who have believed, do not take as intimates those other than yourselves, for they will not spare you [any] ruin. They wish you would have hardship. Hatred has already appeared from their mouths, and what their breasts conceal is greater. We have certainly made clear to you the signs, if you will use reason.

ayahs.ar: هٰ٘اَنۡتُمۡ اُولَآءِ تُحِبُّوۡنَهُمۡ وَلَا يُحِبُّوۡنَكُمۡ وَتُؤۡمِنُوۡنَ بِالۡكِتٰبِ كُلِّهٖۚ وَاِذَا لَقُوۡكُمۡ قَالُوۡ٘ا اٰمَنَّاۚࣗۖ وَاِذَا خَلَوۡا عَضُّوۡا عَلَيۡكُمُ الۡاَنَامِلَ مِنَ الۡغَيۡظِؕ قُلۡ مُوۡتُوۡا بِغَيۡظِكُمۡؕ اِنَّ اللّٰهَ عَلِيۡمٌۭ بِذَاتِ الصُّدُوۡرِ
ayahs.tl: Haaa antum ulaaa'i tuhibboonahum wa laa yuhibboonakum wa tu'minoona bil kitaabi kullihee wa izaa laqookum qaalooo aamannaa wa izaa khalaw 'addoo 'alaikumul anaamila minal ghaiz; qul mootoo bighai zikum; innal laaha 'aleemum bizaatis sudoor
ayahs.en: Here you are loving them but they are not loving you, while you believe in the Scripture - all of it. And when they meet you, they say, "We believe." But when they are alone, they bite their fingertips at you in rage. Say, "Die in your rage. Indeed, Allah is Knowing of that within the breasts."

ayahs.ar: اِنۡ تَمۡسَسۡكُمۡ حَسَنَةٌ تَسُؤۡهُمۡؗ وَاِنۡ تُصِبۡكُمۡ سَيِّئَةٌ يَّفۡرَحُوۡا بِهَاؕ وَاِنۡ تَصۡبِرُوۡا وَتَتَّقُوۡا لَا يَضُرُّكُمۡ كَيۡدُهُمۡ شَيۡـًٔاؕ اِنَّ اللّٰهَ بِمَا يَعۡمَلُوۡنَ مُحِيۡطٌࣖ‏
ayahs.tl: In tamsaskum hasanatun tasu'hum wa in tusibkum saiyi'atuny yafrahoo bihaa wa in tasbiroo wa tattaqoo laa yad urrukum kaiduhum shai'aa; innal laaha bimaa ya'maloona muheet
ayahs.en: If good touches you, it distresses them; but if harm strikes you, they rejoice at it. And if you are patient and fear Allah, their plot will not harm you at all. Indeed, Allah is encompassing of what they do.

ayahs.ar: وَاِذۡ غَدَوۡتَ مِنۡ اَهۡلِكَ تُبَوِّئُ الۡمُؤۡمِنِيۡنَ مَقَاعِدَ لِلۡقِتَالِؕ وَاللّٰهُ سَمِيۡعٌ عَلِيۡمٌۙ‏
ayahs.tl: Wa iz ghadawta min ahlika tubawwi'ul mu'mineena maqaa'ida lilqitaal; wallaahu samee'un 'aleem
ayahs.en: And [remember] when you, [O Muhammad], left your family in the morning to post the believers at their stations for the battle [of Uhud] - and Allah is Hearing and Knowing -

ayahs.ar: اِذۡ هَمَّتۡ طَّآئِفَتٰنِ مِنۡكُمۡ اَنۡ تَفۡشَلَاۙ وَاللّٰهُ وَلِيُّهُمَاؕ وَعَلَي اللّٰهِ فَلۡيَتَوَكَّلِ الۡمُؤۡمِنُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Iz hammat taaa'ifataani minkum an tafshalaa wallaahu waliyyuhumaa; wa 'alal laahi falyatawakkalil mu'minoon
ayahs.en: When two parties among you were about to lose courage, but Allah was their ally; and upon Allah the believers should rely.

ayahs.ar: وَلَقَدۡ نَصَرَكُمُ اللّٰهُ بِبَدۡرٍ وَّاَنۡتُمۡ اَذِلَّةٌۚ فَاتَّقُوا اللّٰهَ لَعَلَّكُمۡ تَشۡكُرُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wa laqad nasarakumul laahu bi-Badrinw wa antum azillatun fattaqul laaha la'allakum tashkuroon
ayahs.en: And already had Allah given you victory at [the battle of] Badr while you were few in number. Then fear Allah; perhaps you will be grateful.

ayahs.ar: اِذۡ تَقُوۡلُ لِلۡمُؤۡمِنِيۡنَ اَلَنۡ يَّكۡفِيَكُمۡ اَنۡ يُّمِدَّكُمۡ رَبُّكُمۡ بِثَلٰثَةِ اٰلٰفٍ مِّنَ الۡمَلٰٓئِكَةِ مُنۡزَلِيۡنَؕ‏
ayahs.tl: Iz taqoolu lilmu'mineena alai yakfiyakum ai-yumiddakum Rabbukum bisalaasati aalaafim minal malaaa'ikati munzaleen
ayahs.en: [Remember] when you said to the believers, "Is it not sufficient for you that your Lord should reinforce you with three thousand angels sent down?

ayahs.ar: بَلٰ٘يۙ اِنۡ تَصۡبِرُوۡا وَتَتَّقُوۡا وَيَاۡتُوۡكُمۡ مِّنۡ فَوۡرِهِمۡ هٰذَا يُمۡدِدۡكُمۡ رَبُّكُمۡ بِخَمۡسَةِ اٰلٰفٍ مِّنَ الۡمَلٰٓئِكَةِ مُسَوِّمِيۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Balaaa; in tasbiroo wa tattaqoo wa yaatookum min fawrihim haazaa yumdidkum Rabbukum bikhamsati aalaafim minal malaaa'ikati musawwaimeen
ayahs.en: Yes, if you remain patient and conscious of Allah and the enemy come upon you [attacking] in rage, your Lord will reinforce you with five thousand angels having marks [of distinction]

ayahs.ar: وَمَا جَعَلَهُ اللّٰهُ اِلَّا بُشۡرٰي لَكُمۡ وَلِتَطۡمَئِنَّ قُلُوۡبُكُمۡ بِهٖؕ وَمَا النَّصۡرُ اِلَّا مِنۡ عِنۡدِ اللّٰهِ الۡعَزِيۡزِ الۡحَكِيۡمِۙ‏
ayahs.tl: Wa maa ja'alahul laahu illaa bushraa lakum wa litatma'inna quloobukum bih' wa man-nasru illaa min 'indilllaahil 'Azeezil Hakeem
ayahs.en: And Allah made it not except as [a sign of] good tidings for you and to reassure your hearts thereby. And victory is not except from Allah, the Exalted in Might, the Wise -

ayahs.ar: لِيَقۡطَعَ طَرَفًا مِّنَ الَّذِيۡنَ كَفَرُوۡ٘ا اَوۡ يَكۡبِتَهُمۡ فَيَنۡقَلِبُوۡا خَآئِبِيۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Laiyaqta'a tarafam minal lazeena kafarooo aw yakbitahum fayanqaliboo khaaa'ibeen
ayahs.en: That He might cut down a section of the disbelievers or suppress them so that they turn back disappointed.

ayahs.ar: لَيۡسَ لَكَ مِنَ الۡاَمۡرِ شَيۡءٌ اَوۡ يَتُوۡبَ عَلَيۡهِمۡ اَوۡ يُعَذِّبَهُمۡ فَاِنَّهُمۡ ظٰلِمُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Laisa laka minal amrishai'un aw yatooba 'alaihim aw yu'az zi bahum fa innahum zaalimoon
ayahs.en: Not for you, [O Muhammad, but for Allah], is the decision whether He should [cut them down] or forgive them or punish them, for indeed, they are wrongdoers.

ayahs.ar: وَلِلّٰهِ مَا فِي السَّمٰوٰتِ وَمَا فِي الۡاَرۡضِؕ يَغۡفِرُ لِمَنۡ يَّشَآءُ وَيُعَذِّبُ مَنۡ يَّشَآءُؕ وَاللّٰهُ غَفُوۡرٌ رَّحِيۡمٌࣖ‏
ayahs.tl: Wa lilaahi maa fissamaawaati wa maa fil-ard; yaghfiru limai-yashaaa'u wa yu'azzibu mai-yashaaa'; wallaahu Ghafoorur Raheem
ayahs.en: And to Allah belongs whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth. He forgives whom He wills and punishes whom He wills. And Allah is Forgiving and Merciful.

ayahs.ar: يٰ٘اَيُّهَا الَّذِيۡنَ اٰمَنُوۡا لَا تَاۡكُلُوا الرِّبٰ٘وا اَضۡعَافًا مُّضٰعَفَةًࣕ وَاتَّقُوا اللّٰهَ لَعَلَّكُمۡ تُفۡلِحُوۡنَۚ‏
ayahs.tl: Yaaa ayyuhal lazeena aamanoo la taakuhur ribaaa ad'aafam mudaa'afatanw wattaqul laaha la'allakum tuflihoon
ayahs.en: O you who have believed, do not consume usury, doubled and multiplied, but fear Allah that you may be successful.

ayahs.ar: وَاتَّقُوا النَّارَ الَّتِيۡ٘ اُعِدَّتۡ لِلۡكٰفِرِيۡنَۚ‏
ayahs.tl: Wattaqun Naaral lateee u'iddat lilkaafireen
ayahs.en: And fear the Fire, which has been prepared for the disbelievers.

ayahs.ar: وَاَطِيۡعُوا اللّٰهَ وَالرَّسُوۡلَ لَعَلَّكُمۡ تُرۡحَمُوۡنَۚ‏
ayahs.tl: Wa atee'ul laaha war Rasoola la'allakum turhamoon
ayahs.en: And obey Allah and the Messenger that you may obtain mercy.

ayahs.ar: وَسَارِعُوۡ٘ا اِلٰي مَغۡفِرَةٍ مِّنۡ رَّبِّكُمۡ وَجَنَّةٍ عَرۡضُهَا السَّمٰوٰتُ وَالۡاَرۡضُۙ اُعِدَّتۡ لِلۡمُتَّقِيۡنَۙ‏
ayahs.tl: Wa saari'ooo ilaa maghfiratim mir Rabbikum wa Jannatin arduhassamaawaatu wal ardu u'iddat lilmuttaqeen
ayahs.en: And hasten to forgiveness from your Lord and a garden as wide as the heavens and earth, prepared for the righteous

ayahs.ar: الَّذِيۡنَ يُنۡفِقُوۡنَ فِي السَّرَّآءِ وَالضَّرَّآءِ وَالۡكٰظِمِيۡنَ الۡغَيۡظَ وَالۡعَافِيۡنَ عَنِ النَّاسِؕ وَاللّٰهُ يُحِبُّ الۡمُحۡسِنِيۡنَۚ‏
ayahs.tl: Allazeena yunfiqoona fissarraaa'i waddarraaa'i wal kaazimeenal ghaiza wal aafeena 'anin-naas; wallaahu yuhibbul muhsineen
ayahs.en: Who spend [in the cause of Allah] during ease and hardship and who restrain anger and who pardon the people - and Allah loves the doers of good;

ayahs.ar: وَالَّذِيۡنَ اِذَا فَعَلُوۡا فَاحِشَةً اَوۡ ظَلَمُوۡ٘ا اَنۡفُسَهُمۡ ذَكَرُوا اللّٰهَ فَاسۡتَغۡفَرُوۡا لِذُنُوۡبِهِمۡࣞ وَمَنۡ يَّغۡفِرُ الذُّنُوۡبَ اِلَّا اللّٰهُࣕࣞ وَلَمۡ يُصِرُّوۡا عَلٰي مَا فَعَلُوۡا وَهُمۡ يَعۡلَمُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wallazeena izaa fa'aloo faahishatan aw zalamooo anfusahum zakarul laaha fastaghfaroo lizunoobihim; wa mai yaghfiruz zunooba illal laahu wa lam yusirroo 'alaa maa fa'aloo wa hum ya'lamooo
ayahs.en: And those who, when they commit an immorality or wrong themselves [by transgression], remember Allah and seek forgiveness for their sins - and who can forgive sins except Allah? - and [who] do not persist in what they have done while they know.

ayahs.ar: اُولٰٓئِكَ جَزَآؤُهُمۡ مَّغۡفِرَةٌ مِّنۡ رَّبِّهِمۡ وَجَنّٰتٌ تَجۡرِيۡ مِنۡ تَحۡتِهَا الۡاَنۡهٰرُ خٰلِدِيۡنَ فِيۡهَاؕ وَنِعۡمَ اَجۡرُ الۡعٰمِلِيۡنَؕ‏
ayahs.tl: Ulaaa'ika jazaaa'uhum maghfiratum mir Rabbihim wa Jannaatun tajree min tahtihal anhaaru khaalideena feeha; wa ni'ma ajrul 'aamileen
ayahs.en: Those - their reward is forgiveness from their Lord and gardens beneath which rivers flow [in Paradise], wherein they will abide eternally; and excellent is the reward of the [righteous] workers.

ayahs.ar: قَدۡ خَلَتۡ مِنۡ قَبۡلِكُمۡ سُنَنٌۙ فَسِيۡرُوۡا فِي الۡاَرۡضِ فَانۡظُرُوۡا كَيۡفَ كَانَ عَاقِبَةُ الۡمُكَذِّبِيۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Qad khalat min qablikum sunanum faseeroo fil ardi fanzuroo kaifa kaana 'aaqiba tul mukazzibeen
ayahs.en: Similar situations [as yours] have passed on before you, so proceed throughout the earth and observe how was the end of those who denied.

ayahs.ar: هٰذَا بَيَانٌ لِّلنَّاسِ وَهُدًي وَّمَوۡعِظَةٌ لِّلۡمُتَّقِيۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Haazaa bayaanul linnaasi wa hudanw wa maw'izatul lilmuttaqeen
ayahs.en: This [Qur'an] is a clear statement to [all] the people and a guidance and instruction for those conscious of Allah.

ayahs.ar: وَلَا تَهِنُوۡا وَلَا تَحۡزَنُوۡا وَاَنۡتُمُ الۡاَعۡلَوۡنَ اِنۡ كُنۡتُمۡ مُّؤۡمِنِيۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wa laa tahinoo wa laa tahzanoo wa antumul a'lawna in kuntum mu'mineen
ayahs.en: So do not weaken and do not grieve, and you will be superior if you are [true] believers.

ayahs.ar: اِنۡ يَّمۡسَسۡكُمۡ قَرۡحٌ فَقَدۡ مَسَّ الۡقَوۡمَ قَرۡحٌ مِّثۡلُهٗؕ وَتِلۡكَ الۡاَيَّامُ نُدَاوِلُهَا بَيۡنَ النَّاسِۚ وَلِيَعۡلَمَ اللّٰهُ الَّذِيۡنَ اٰمَنُوۡا وَيَتَّخِذَ مِنۡكُمۡ شُهَدَآءَؕ وَاللّٰهُ لَا يُحِبُّ الظّٰلِمِيۡنَۙ‏
ayahs.tl: Iny-yamsaskum qarhum faqad massal qawma qarhum misluh; wa tilkal ayyaamu nudaawiluhaa bainan naasi wa liya'lamal laahul lazeena aamanoo wa yattakhiza minkum shuhadaaa'; wallaahu laa yuh ibbuz zaalimeen
ayahs.en: If a wound should touch you - there has already touched the [opposing] people a wound similar to it. And these days [of varying conditions] We alternate among the people so that Allah may make evident those who believe and [may] take to Himself from among you martyrs - and Allah does not like the wrongdoers -

ayahs.ar: وَلِيُمَحِّصَ اللّٰهُ الَّذِيۡنَ اٰمَنُوۡا وَيَمۡحَقَ الۡكٰفِرِيۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wa liyumahhisal laahul lazeena aamanoo wa yamhaqal kaafireen
ayahs.en: And that Allah may purify the believers [through trials] and destroy the disbelievers.

ayahs.ar: اَمۡ حَسِبۡتُمۡ اَنۡ تَدۡخُلُوا الۡجَنَّةَ وَلَمَّا يَعۡلَمِ اللّٰهُ الَّذِيۡنَ جٰهَدُوۡا مِنۡكُمۡ وَيَعۡلَمَ الصّٰبِرِيۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Am hasibtum an tadkhulul Jannnata wa lammaa ya'lamil laahul lazeena jaahadoo minkum wa ya'lamas saabireen
ayahs.en: Or do you think that you will enter Paradise while Allah has not yet made evident those of you who fight in His cause and made evident those who are steadfast?

ayahs.ar: وَلَقَدۡ كُنۡتُمۡ تَمَنَّوۡنَ الۡمَوۡتَ مِنۡ قَبۡلِ اَنۡ تَلۡقَوۡهُࣕ فَقَدۡ رَاَيۡتُمُوۡهُ وَاَنۡتُمۡ تَنۡظُرُوۡنَࣖ‏
ayahs.tl: Wa laqad kuntum tamannnawnal mawta min qabli an talqawhu faqad ra aitumoohu wa antum tanzuroon
ayahs.en: And you had certainly wished for martyrdom before you encountered it, and you have [now] seen it [before you] while you were looking on.

ayahs.ar: وَمَا مُحَمَّدٌ اِلَّا رَسُوۡلٌۚ قَدۡ خَلَتۡ مِنۡ قَبۡلِهِ الرُّسُلُؕ اَفَا۠ئِنۡ مَّاتَ اَوۡ قُتِلَ انۡقَلَبۡتُمۡ عَلٰ٘ي اَعۡقَابِكُمۡؕ وَمَنۡ يَّنۡقَلِبۡ عَلٰي عَقِبَيۡهِ فَلَنۡ يَّضُرَّ اللّٰهَ شَيۡـًٔاؕ وَسَيَجۡزِي اللّٰهُ الشّٰكِرِيۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wa maa Muhammadun illaa Rasoolun qad khalat min qablihir Rusul; afa'im maata aw qutilan qalabtum 'alaaa a'qaabikum; wa mai yanqalib 'alaa aqibihi falai yadurral laaha shai'aa; wa sayajzil laahush shaakireen
ayahs.en: Muhammad is not but a messenger. [Other] messengers have passed on before him. So if he was to die or be killed, would you turn back on your heels [to unbelief]? And he who turns back on his heels will never harm Allah at all; but Allah will reward the grateful.

ayahs.ar: وَمَا كَانَ لِنَفۡسٍ اَنۡ تَمُوۡتَ اِلَّا بِاِذۡنِ اللّٰهِ كِتٰبًا مُّؤَجَّلًاؕ وَمَنۡ يُّرِدۡ ثَوَابَ الدُّنۡيَا نُؤۡتِهٖ مِنۡهَاۚ وَمَنۡ يُّرِدۡ ثَوَابَ الۡاٰخِرَةِ نُؤۡتِهٖ مِنۡهَاؕ وَسَنَجۡزِي الشّٰكِرِيۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wa maa kaana linafsin an tamoota illaa bi iznillaahi kitaabam mu'ajjalaa; wa mai yurid sawaabad dunyaa nu'tihee minhaa wa mai yurid sawaabal Aakhirati nu'tihee minhaa; wa sanajzish shaakireen
ayahs.en: And it is not [possible] for one to die except by permission of Allah at a decree determined. And whoever desires the reward of this world - We will give him thereof; and whoever desires the reward of the Hereafter - We will give him thereof. And we will reward the grateful.

ayahs.ar: وَكَاَيِّنۡ مِّنۡ نَّبِيٍّ قٰتَلَۙ مَعَهٗ رِبِّيُّوۡنَ كَثِيۡرٌۚ فَمَا وَهَنُوۡا لِمَا٘ اَصَابَهُمۡ فِيۡ سَبِيۡلِ اللّٰهِ وَمَا ضَعُفُوۡا وَمَا اسۡتَكَانُوۡاؕ وَاللّٰهُ يُحِبُّ الصّٰبِرِيۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wa ka aiyim min Nabiyyin qaatala ma'ahoo ribbiyyoona kaseerun famaa wahanoo limaaa Asaabahum fee sabeelil laahi wa maa da'ufoo wa mas takaanoo; wallaahu yuhibbus saabireen
ayahs.en: And how many a prophet [fought and] with him fought many religious scholars. But they never lost assurance due to what afflicted them in the cause of Allah, nor did they weaken or submit. And Allah loves the steadfast.

ayahs.ar: وَمَا كَانَ قَوۡلَهُمۡ اِلَّا٘ اَنۡ قَالُوۡا رَبَّنَا اغۡفِرۡ لَنَا ذُنُوۡبَنَا وَاِسۡرَافَنَا فِيۡ٘ اَمۡرِنَا وَثَبِّتۡ اَقۡدَامَنَا وَانۡصُرۡنَا عَلَي الۡقَوۡمِ الۡكٰفِرِيۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wa maa kaana qawlahum illaa an qaaloo Rabbanagh fir lanaa zunoobanaa wa israafanaa feee amirnaa wa sabbit aqdaamanaa wansurnaa 'alal qawmil kaafireen
ayahs.en: And their words were not but that they said, "Our Lord, forgive us our sins and the excess [committed] in our affairs and plant firmly our feet and give us victory over the disbelieving people."

ayahs.ar: فَاٰتٰىهُمُ اللّٰهُ ثَوَابَ الدُّنۡيَا وَحُسۡنَ ثَوَابِ الۡاٰخِرَةِؕ وَاللّٰهُ يُحِبُّ الۡمُحۡسِنِيۡنَࣖ‏
ayahs.tl: Fa aataahumul laahu sawaabad dunyaa wa husna sawaabil Aakhirah; wallaahu yuhibbul muhsineen
ayahs.en: So Allah gave them the reward of this world and the good reward of the Hereafter. And Allah loves the doers of good.

ayahs.ar: يٰ٘اَيُّهَا الَّذِيۡنَ اٰمَنُوۡ٘ا اِنۡ تُطِيۡعُوا الَّذِيۡنَ كَفَرُوۡا يَرُدُّوۡكُمۡ عَلٰ٘ي اَعۡقَابِكُمۡ فَتَنۡقَلِبُوۡا خٰسِرِيۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Yaaa 'aiyuhal lazeena aamanoo in tutee'ullazeena kafaroo yaruddookum 'alaaa a'qaabkum fatanqaliboo khaasireen
ayahs.en: O you who have believed, if you obey those who disbelieve, they will turn you back on your heels, and you will [then] become losers.

ayahs.ar: بَلِ اللّٰهُ مَوۡلٰىكُمۡۚ وَهُوَ خَيۡرُ النّٰصِرِيۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Balil laahu mawlaakum wa Huwa khairun naasireen
ayahs.en: But Allah is your protector, and He is the best of helpers.

ayahs.ar: سَنُلۡقِيۡ فِيۡ قُلُوۡبِ الَّذِيۡنَ كَفَرُوا الرُّعۡبَ بِمَا٘ اَشۡرَكُوۡا بِاللّٰهِ مَا لَمۡ يُنَزِّلۡ بِهٖ سُلۡطٰنًاۚ وَمَاۡوٰىهُمُ النَّارُؕ وَبِئۡسَ مَثۡوَي الظّٰلِمِيۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Sanulqee fee quloobil lazeena kafarur ru'ba bimaaa ashrakoo billaahi maa lam yunazzil bihee sultaana-nw wa maawaahumun Naar; wa bi'sa maswaz zaalimeen
ayahs.en: We will cast terror into the hearts of those who disbelieve for what they have associated with Allah of which He had not sent down [any] authority. And their refuge will be the Fire, and wretched is the residence of the wrongdoers.

ayahs.ar: وَلَقَدۡ صَدَقَكُمُ اللّٰهُ وَعۡدَهٗ٘ اِذۡ تَحُسُّوۡنَهُمۡ بِاِذۡنِهٖۚ حَتّٰ٘ي اِذَا فَشِلۡتُمۡ وَتَنَازَعۡتُمۡ فِي الۡاَمۡرِ وَعَصَيۡتُمۡ مِّنۭۡ بَعۡدِ مَا٘ اَرٰىكُمۡ مَّا تُحِبُّوۡنَؕ مِنۡكُمۡ مَّنۡ يُّرِيۡدُ الدُّنۡيَا وَمِنۡكُمۡ مَّنۡ يُّرِيۡدُ الۡاٰخِرَةَۚ ثُمَّ صَرَفَكُمۡ عَنۡهُمۡ لِيَبۡتَلِيَكُمۡۚ وَلَقَدۡ عَفَا عَنۡكُمۡؕ وَاللّٰهُ ذُوۡ فَضۡلٍ عَلَي الۡمُؤۡمِنِيۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wa laqad sadaqakumul laahu wa'dahooo iz tahussoo nahum bi iznihee hattaaa izaa fashiltim wa tanaaza'tum fil amri wa 'asaitum mim ba'di maaa araakum maa tuhibboon; minkum mai yureedud dunyaa wa minkum mai yureedul Aakhirah; summa sarafakum 'anhum sarafakum 'anhum liyabtaliyakum wa laqad 'afaa 'ankum; wallaahu zoo fadlin 'alal mu'mineen
ayahs.en: And Allah had certainly fulfilled His promise to you when you were killing the enemy by His permission until [the time] when you lost courage and fell to disputing about the order [given by the Prophet] and disobeyed after He had shown you that which you love. Among you are some who desire this world, and among you are some who desire the Hereafter. Then he turned you back from them [defeated] that He might test you. And He has already forgiven you, and Allah is the possessor of bounty for the believers.

ayahs.ar: اِذۡ تُصۡعِدُوۡنَ وَلَا تَلۡوٗنَ عَلٰ٘ي اَحَدٍ وَّالرَّسُوۡلُ يَدۡعُوۡكُمۡ فِيۡ٘ اُخۡرٰىكُمۡ فَاَثَابَكُمۡ غَمًّاۭ بِغَمٍّ لِّكَيۡلَا تَحۡزَنُوۡا عَلٰي مَا فَاتَكُمۡ وَلَا مَا٘ اَصَابَكُمۡؕ وَاللّٰهُ خَبِيۡرٌۭ بِمَا تَعۡمَلُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Iz tus'idoona wa laa talwoona 'alaaa ahadinw war Rasoolu yad'ookum feee ukhraakum fa asaabakum ghammam bighammil likailaa tahzanoo 'alaa maa faatakum wa laa maaa asaabakum; wallaahu khabeerum bimaa ta'maloon
ayahs.en: [Remember] when you [fled and] climbed [the mountain] without looking aside at anyone while the Messenger was calling you from behind. So Allah repaid you with distress upon distress so you would not grieve for that which had escaped you [of victory and spoils of war] or [for] that which had befallen you [of injury and death]. And Allah is [fully] Acquainted with what you do.

ayahs.ar: ثُمَّ اَنۡزَلَ عَلَيۡكُمۡ مِّنۭۡ بَعۡدِ الۡغَمِّ اَمَنَةً نُّعَاسًا يَّغۡشٰي طَآئِفَةً مِّنۡكُمۡۙ وَطَآئِفَةٌ قَدۡ اَهَمَّتۡهُمۡ اَنۡفُسُهُمۡ يَظُنُّوۡنَ بِاللّٰهِ غَيۡرَ الۡحَقِّ ظَنَّ الۡجَاهِلِيَّةِؕ يَقُوۡلُوۡنَ هَلۡ لَّنَا مِنَ الۡاَمۡرِ مِنۡ شَيۡءٍؕ قُلۡ اِنَّ الۡاَمۡرَ كُلَّهٗ لِلّٰهِؕ يُخۡفُوۡنَ فِيۡ٘ اَنۡفُسِهِمۡ مَّا لَا يُبۡدُوۡنَ لَكَؕ يَقُوۡلُوۡنَ لَوۡ كَانَ لَنَا مِنَ الۡاَمۡرِ شَيۡءٌ مَّا قُتِلۡنَا هٰهُنَاؕ قُلۡ لَّوۡ كُنۡتُمۡ فِيۡ بُيُوۡتِكُمۡ لَبَرَزَ الَّذِيۡنَ كُتِبَ عَلَيۡهِمُ الۡقَتۡلُ اِلٰي مَضَاجِعِهِمۡۚ وَلِيَبۡتَلِيَ اللّٰهُ مَا فِيۡ صُدُوۡرِكُمۡ وَلِيُمَحِّصَ مَا فِيۡ قُلُوۡبِكُمۡؕ وَاللّٰهُ عَلِيۡمٌۭ بِذَاتِ الصُّدُوۡرِ
ayahs.tl: Summa anzala 'alaikum mim ba'dil ghammi amanatan nu'aasai yaghshaa taaa' ifatam minkum wa taaa'ifatun qad ahammathum anfusuhum yazunnoona billaahi ghairal haqqi zannal jaahiliyyati yaqooloona hal lanaa minal amri min shai'; qul innal amra kullahoo lillaah; yukhfoona fee anfusihim maa laa yubdoona laka yaqooloona law kaana lanaa minal amri shai'ummaa qutilnaa haahunaa; qul law kuntum fee buyootikum labarazal lazeena kutiba 'alaihimul qatlu ilaa madaaji'ihim wa liyabtaliyal laahu maa fee sudoorikum wa liyumah hisa maa fee quloobikum; wallaahu 'aleemum bizaatis sudoor
ayahs.en: Then after distress, He sent down upon you security [in the form of] drowsiness, overcoming a faction of you, while another faction worried about themselves, thinking of Allah other than the truth - the thought of ignorance, saying, "Is there anything for us [to have done] in this matter?"
